item.title: President Lee's Tears at Parents' Day Address: "Wishing Health and Peace to All Parents in This Land" (李대통령, 눈물의 어버이날 축사 “이 땅의 모든 부모님들께 건강과 평안이 함께 하길”)
item.description:
President Lee's Tears at Parents' Day Address: "Wishing Health and Peace to All Parents in This Land" (李대통령, 눈물의 어버이날 축사 “이 땅의 모든 부모님들께 건강과 평안이 함께 하길”)

President Lee Jae-myung shed tears at the 54th Parents' Day ceremony on the 8th, pledging that the state would fulfill the duties and responsibilities of filial piety toward the parents of fallen public officials. <<> During the ceremony held that morning at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, President Lee attended the 54th Parents' Day event, pinned carnations on behalf of their children for the parents of fallen public officials, and delivered a speech. President Lee said, "As I handed out the carnations, I found myself tearing up too," adding, "Your hearts must be aching. I offer my condolences." First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, who was also present, showed tears as well. This marks the first time a presidential couple has attended the Parents' Day ceremony together. <<> In the latter part of the speech, when President Lee mentioned, "There are those who are suffering, longing for family they can no longer meet," his voice choked and trembled, and he struggled to continue. President Lee continued in a faltering voice, "Here today with us are the parents of fallen public officials who left our side while protecting the lives of the people." <<> President Lee stated, "I know well that before the sorrow of having to send a beloved child away first, no words can fully offer comfort," and said, "I will solemnly remember the noble sacrifice of those young people who fulfilled their duties to the very end in the most dangerous sites." He added, "With the resolve that the state will fulfill its filial duties and responsibilities and stay by your side until the end, I have pinned carnations for the bereaved families today," and "I pray for health and peace to be with all parents in this land." <<> President Lee also remarked, "A parent carries the world as many times as the number of children they have," adding, "It's something I only truly realized after becoming a father of two." He emphasized, "I extend deep respect and gratitude to all parents in this land who are dedicated to their families and the nation," and "Rather than a society reliant on the unilateral sacrifice of parents, I will move toward a 'country where all citizens are happy,' where the state and community share responsibility." <<> President Lee said, "Fathers and mothers who have devoted their entire lives must be able to enjoy a worry-free and happy old age," adding, "Only in a country where raising children is not a burden to parents and supporting parents is not a burden to children can everyone affirm tomorrow's life and dream of a better future." <<> President Lee announced, "The people's sovereignty government is diligently preparing institutional measures to ensure a healthy and vibrant old age, such as 'integrated community care,' 'dementia-safe property management services,' a record high of '1.15 million senior jobs,' and improvements to unreasonable pension systems," and stated, "Going forward, we will care for the lives of parents more attentively and meticulously, and continuously expand practical systems and support." <<> About 230 people were invited to the ceremony, including exemplary filial piety awardees, parents of fallen fire and police officials, and elderly individuals living alone. Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, Senior Presidential Secretary for Social Affairs Moon Jin-young, Minister of Health and Welfare Jeong Eun-kyung, and President of the Korean Senior Citizens Association Lee Jung-geun attended. Parents of police and fire officials who died while responding to incidents such as fires in Mungyeong, North Gyeongsang Province, and Gimje, North Jeolla Province, were present. <<> Regarding the attendance of only Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae among party leaders at the ceremony, President Lee asked Minister Jeong Eun-kyung, "You invited all party leaders, right? Surely you didn't only invite Representative Jeong Cheong-rae," and then explained, "Because it's a sensitive time, I was worried there might be strange misunderstandings, so I said the others couldn't come due to busy schedules." (이재명 대통령이 8일 제54회 어버이날 기념식에서 순직 공무원 부모님들께 국가가 자식의 도리와 책임을 다하겠다고 밝히며 눈물을 흘렸다.)

item.title: President Lee Discusses Strengthening Security and Energy Cooperation with Canadian Prime Minister (李대통령, 캐나다 총리와 통화 “안보·에너지 협력 강화")
item.description:
President Lee Discusses Strengthening Security and Energy Cooperation with Canadian Prime Minister (李대통령, 캐나다 총리와 통화 “안보·에너지 협력 강화")

President Lee Jae-myung spoke by phone with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the 8th, discussing ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation amid the global supply chain and energy crises. (이재명 대통령은 8일 마크 카니 캐나다 총리와 통화하고, 글로벌 공급망·에너지 위기 속에서 양국 간 협력 강화 방안을 논의했다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung announced in a written briefing following the call between President Lee and Prime Minister Carney that morning, stating, "The two leaders agreed that the two countries should cooperate more closely in efforts to peacefully resolve the situation in the Middle East, ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and stabilize energy supply and demand within the international community." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 오전 이 대통령과 카니 총리의 통화 뒤 서면 브리핑을 통해 “양 정상은 중동 상황의 평화적 해결과 호르무즈 해협 항행의 자유 보장, 안정적인 에너지 수급을 위한 국제 사회의 노력에 있어서도 양국이 더욱 긴밀히 협력해 나가야 한다는 점에 공감했다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee and Prime Minister Carney assessed that the follow-up measures from the South Korea-Canada summit held on the sidelines of the APEC (Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation) summit in Gyeongju last October are being implemented smoothly. The presidential office reported that they noted bilateral relations are expanding beyond security cooperation to encompass various fields including economy, energy, high-tech industries, and culture, and agreed to further deepen strategic cooperation based on this trend. (이 대통령과 카니 총리는 지난해 10월 경주에서 열린 APEC(아시아태평양경제협력체) 정상회의 계기에 가진 한·캐나다 정상회담의 후속 조치가 원만히 이행 중이라고 평가했다. 그러면서 양국 관계가 안보 협력을 넘어 경제, 에너지, 첨단 산업, 문화를 아우르는 다방면으로 확대되고 있다며, 이런 추세를 바탕으로 전략적 협력을 더욱 심화해 나가는 데 의견을 모았다고 청와대는 전했다.)

Senior Secretary Kang said President Lee stated, "For South Korea, Canada is a key ally, and I hope that South Korea and Canada will further strengthen cooperation in various areas such as security, economy, energy, critical minerals, and high-tech industries amid the recent instability in the international order." Prime Minister Carney agreed, replying, "It is important for middle powers like Canada and South Korea to strengthen solidarity with a more pragmatic approach." (이 대통령은 “한국에게 캐나다는 핵심 우방국이며, 최근 국제 질서가 불안정한 상황에서 한국과 캐나다가 안보, 경제, 에너지, 핵심광물, 첨단산업 등 다양한 분야에서 협력을 더욱 강화해 나가기를 기대한다”고 말했고, 카니 총리도 이에 공감하며 “캐나다와 한국 등 중견국들이 보다 실용적 접근 하에 연대를 강화하는 것이 중요하다”고 답했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다.)

The phone call between the two leaders took place as South Korean companies are competing in the bidding for Canada's 'Next-Generation Submarine Project (CPSP),' valued at up to 60 trillion won. This has led to interpretations that President Lee has stepped up to support winning the submarine project contract. (이날 양국 정상 간 통화는, 캐나다가 추진하는 최대 60조원 규모의 ‘차세대 잠수함 사업(CPSP)’ 수주전에서 우리 기업이 경쟁 중인 가운데 이뤄졌다. 이 때문에 이 대통령이 잠수함 사업 수주를 위한 지원에 나섰다는 해석도 나왔다.)

Currently, a consortium of Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries is competing against Germany's TKMS. The results are expected to be announced as early as the end of next month. Given the project's enormous scale, competition is intense not only at the corporate level but also at the national level. Earlier, Minister of Trade, Industry, and Energy Kim Jung-kwan visited Canada on the 5th and 6th (local time), meeting with Canadian Minister of Industry Melanie Joly and Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Tim Hodgson to support efforts to secure the submarine project order. (현재 한화오션·HD현대중공업 컨소시엄이 독일 TKMS와 경쟁 중이다. 이르면 다음 달 말 결과가 발표될 예정이다. 워낙 규모가 큰 사업이기 때문에, 기업을 넘어 국가적 차원에서도 경쟁이 치열한 상황이다. 앞서 김정관 산업통상부 장관은 지난 5~6일(현지 시각) 캐나다를 찾아 캐나다의 멜라니 졸리 산업부 장관, 팀 호지슨 에너지·천연자원부 장관 등을 만나 잠수함 프로젝트 수주 지원 활동을 벌였다.)

item.title: Blue House Expresses Regret to People Power Party Over Failed Constitutional Amendment Vote (靑, 개헌안 표결 무산에 “국민의힘에 유감 표해”)
item.description:
Blue House Expresses Regret to People Power Party Over Failed Constitutional Amendment Vote (靑, 개헌안 표결 무산에 “국민의힘에 유감 표해”)

The presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) stated on the 8th that "it expresses regret that the handling of the constitutional amendment bill in the plenary session was ultimately scuttled due to opposition from lawmakers belonging to the People Power Party." (청와대는 8일 “헌법개정안 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 소속 국회의원들의 반대로 끝내 무산된 데 대해 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior presidential spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung made the remarks in a written briefing that day, saying, "We ask that discussions on constitutional amendments continue in the second half of the National Assembly with a more responsible attitude, fulfilling the promise made to the people." The National Assembly attempted to hold a vote on the constitutional amendment bill in the plenary session on this day, as on the previous day, but the vote itself failed to materialize due to the absence of People Power Party lawmakers. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 이같이 밝히며 “후반기 국회에 보다 책임 있는 자세로 개헌 논의를 이어가며 국민과의 약속을 지켜주시길 요청드린다”고 했다. 국회는 전날에 이어 이날도 본회의에서 개헌안 표결을 시도했지만, 국민의힘 의원들의 불참에 따라 투표 자체가 성립되지 않았다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang stated, "This constitutional amendment bill includes incorporating the spirit of the Buma Democracy Protests and the May 18 Democratic Uprising into the preamble of the Constitution, and explicitly stipulates the state's responsibility for balanced regional development and the strengthening of the National Assembly's control authority over martial law," adding, "It was a public demand to reflect the lessons from the illegal martial law incident of December 3 in the Constitution, and there were no major disagreements between the ruling and opposition parties." (강 수석대변인은 “이번 개헌안은 헌법 전문에 부마민주항쟁과 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 담고, 국가의 지역균형발전 책임과 계엄에 대한 국회의 통제 권한 강화를 명시하는 내용을 담고 있다”며 “지난 12·3 불법계엄 사태의 교훈을 헌법에 반영하자는 국민적 요구였으며 여야 간 큰 이견도 없었다”고 했다.)

She continued, "The public will therefore find it difficult to understand the reasons for opposing even this minimal constitutional amendment needed to protect the nation's security and democracy," and stressed, "The discussion on amending the Constitution, which was promised to the people, must never be halted." She also added, "The presidential office will continue to unwaveringly push forward the discussion on constitutional amendments, a task of the times, together with the people." (이어 “이에 국민들은 국가의 안위와 민주주의를 지키기 위한 최소한의 개헌마저 반대한 이유를 납득하기 어려우실 것”이라며 “국민께 약속했던 개헌 논의가 결코 중단되어서는 안 된다”고 했다. 그러면서 “청와대는 앞으로도 시대적 과제인 개헌 논의를 국민과 함께 흔들림 없이 추진해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

For the constitutional amendment bill to pass the plenary session of the National Assembly, it requires the approval of two-thirds of the quorum for voting, meaning at least 12 lawmakers from the People Power Party must participate in the vote and cast their approval. While the People Power Party does not oppose the content of the amendment, it maintains a party line of opposition, calling it "a stratagem for elections." (개헌안이 국회 본회의를 통과되려면 의결정족수의 3분의 2 찬성이 필요해 국민의힘 소속 최소 12명이 투표에 참여해 찬성표를 던져야 한다. 국민의힘은 개헌 내용에 반대하지는 않으면서도, ‘선거용 정략’이라며 당론으로 반대 입장을 견지하고 있다.)

item.title: President, National Assembly Speaker, and Ruling Party Leader All Cried on the Same Day – A Rare Occurrence (대통령·국회의장·여당 대표 같은날 울었다, 이런 날이...)
item.description:
President, National Assembly Speaker, and Ruling Party Leader All Cried on the Same Day – A Rare Occurrence (대통령·국회의장·여당 대표 같은날 울었다, 이런 날이...)

In an unprecedented scene, the President, the National Assembly Speaker, and the ruling party leader all shed tears on the same day, each for their own reasons. (대통령과 국회의장, 여당 대표가 한날 제각각의 이유로 모두 눈물을 흘리는 이례적인 모습이 벌어졌다.)

The first tears were shed by President Lee Jae-myung. During a Parents' Day ceremony held at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul on the 8th, President Lee personally pinned red carnations on the chests of parents of fallen public officials and broke down in tears. (첫 눈물은 이재명 대통령이 흘렸다. 이 대통령은 8일 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 열린 어버이날 기념식에서 순직 공무원 부모 가슴에 빨간 카네이션을 직접 달아주고 눈물을 보였다.)

The recipients included the parents of the late Fire Marshal Kim Su-gwang and Firefighter Park Su-hoon, who died in a fire in Mungyeong, Gyeongsangbuk-do; the parents of the late Fire Marshal Im Seong-cheol, who died in a warehouse fire in Jeju; and the father of the late Firefighter Lee Ho-hyeon, who died in a fire in Gangneung, Gangwon-do. (경북 문경 화재로 순직한 고(故) 김수광 소방장과 박수훈 소방교, 제주 창고 화재로 순직한 고 임성철 소방장의 부모 및 강원 강릉 화재로 순직한 고 이호현 소방교의 부친 등이 대상이었다.)

As he pinned the flowers, President Lee tightly held the parents' hands, while First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, with tears in her eyes, embraced the mother of one fallen public official. Later, during his congratulatory speech, President Lee said, "While handing out the carnations, I suddenly found myself crying," adding, "You must be heartbroken. I offer my condolences," before beginning his address. (이 대통령은 꽃을 달아주며 부모들의 손을 꼭 잡아줬고, 김혜경 여사는 눈물을 글썽이면서 한 순직 공무원의 어머니와 포옹했다. 이후 축사에 나선 이 대통령은 “카네이션을 전달하다 보니 저도 갑자기 눈물이 났다”며 “마음이 아프시겠죠. 위로의 말씀을 드린다”라고 한 뒤 연설을 시작했다.)

He broke down in tears when mentioning the moment he pinned carnations on the parents of the fallen officials. President Lee said, "On Parents' Day, there are those who are in pain, longing for family they can no longer meet," and then struggled to continue. In response, the attendees offered supportive applause. (그러다 순직 공무원 부모에게 카네이션을 달아준 것을 언급하던 대목에서 눈물을 터뜨린 것이다. 이 대통령은 “어버이날, 만나지 못할 가족을 그리워하며 아파하고 계신 분들이 있다”고 말한 뒤 말을 잇지 못했다. 그러자 참석자들이 격려의 박수를 보냈다.)

The second tears were shed by Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea. After a milk delivery experience in Songpa-gu, Seoul, Jeong held an on-site Supreme Council meeting and brought up a secondary special investigation team’s on-site verification of the "Yeonpyeong Island detention center" listed in the "Noh Sang-won notebook." He said, "There were 18 locations with barred cells capable of holding 500 people, isn't that right?" adding, "It truly sends chills down my spine and fills me with rage." (두번째 눈물은 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 흘렸다. 정 대표는 이날 서울 송파구에서 우유 배달 체험을 한 뒤 현장 최고위원회의에서 2차 종합 특별검사팀이 ‘노상원 수첩’에 기재된 연평도 수용소를 현장 검증한 것을 거론하며 “500명을 수용할 수 있는 철창 있는 곳이 18군데나 있었다는 것 아니겠느냐”며 “진짜 치가 떨리고 분노가 치밀어 오른다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "If the martial law had succeeded, President Lee Jae-myung and I might have been trapped there. I recalled the terrifying nightmare of possibly ending up as crab food (in the Yeonpyeong Island sea) on the way there." (그러면서 “만약에 계엄이 성공했더라면 이재명 대통령도, 저도 혹시 그곳에 갇혀 있지 않았을까. 그곳에 가다가 (연평도 바다에서) 꽃게밥이 되지 않았을까' 하는 살 떨리는 악몽 같은 기억이 다시 떠올랐다”고 했다.)

Overcome with emotion during his remarks, Jeong choked up and shed tears, saying, "Ah, I shouldn't be doing this." Nearby, Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh handed him his handkerchief. (정 대표는 발언 도중 감정이 북받쳐 올라 “아, 이러면 안 되는데”라며 울컥하며 눈물을 흘렸다. 이에 옆에 있던 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보가 자신의 손수건을 건네기도 했다.)

The third set of tears came from National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik later that afternoon in the National Assembly chamber. Speaker Woo had convened a plenary session to propose a constitutional amendment bill, but after the People Power Party opposed it with a filibuster and other tactics, he declared, "I will not submit the amendment," and adjourned the session. While continuing a pointed criticism of the People Power Party, he took off his glasses and wiped away tears. (세번째로 우원식 국회의장은 이날 오후 국회 본회의장에서 눈물을 흘렸다. 우 의장은 이날 헌법개정안(개헌안)을 본회의에 상정하려고 본회의를 소집했다가 국민의힘이 필리버스터 등으로 반대한다고 하자 “개헌안을 상정하지 않겠다”면서 산회를 선언했다. 그는 그러면서 국민의힘을 비난하는 작심발언을 이어가다가 안경을 벗고 눈물을 닦았다.)

The sight of President Lee, leader Jeong, and Speaker Woo shedding tears that day was broadcast live through various television channels and social media platforms like YouTube. (이날 이 대통령과 정 대표, 우 의장이 눈물을 흘리는 광경은 각종 방송 채널과 유튜브 등 소셜미디어를 통해 생중계 보도됐다.)

A political insider remarked, "On Parents' Day, it was coincidental that the nation’s key figures, each for different reasons, were seen shedding tears in public on the same day." (정치권 관계자는 “어버이날 공교롭게 국가 요인들이 각기 이유는 다르지만 같은 날 국민들 앞에서 눈물을 흘리는 광경이 펼쳐졌다”고 말했다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "We Will Definitely Block Dictatorial Constitutional Amendment Without Bipartisan Agreement"... Also Criticizes Assembly Speaker Woo’s Overseas Schedule (국힘 “與野 합의 없는 독재 개헌, 기필코 막아내겠다”... 우 의장 순방 일정 비판도)
item.description:
People Power Party: "We Will Definitely Block Dictatorial Constitutional Amendment Without Bipartisan Agreement"... Also Criticizes Assembly Speaker Woo’s Overseas Schedule (국힘 “與野 합의 없는 독재 개헌, 기필코 막아내겠다”... 우 의장 순방 일정 비판도)

Regarding the failure of the constitutional amendment led by the Democratic Party of Korea to pass, the People Power Party stated on the 8th, "We will resolutely block any dictatorial constitutional amendment made without bipartisan agreement, standing with the people to the end." National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik attempted to push through the Democratic Party-led amendment by convening a plenary session that day, but was blocked by opposition from the People Power Party. He then declared, "I will no longer bring it to the floor. All related procedures are halted as of today." Consequently, the plan to hold a national referendum on the amendment alongside the June 3 local elections has collapsed. <<> People Power Party Floor Leader Song Eon-seok held a press conference shortly after Speaker Woo adjourned the plenary session that afternoon, stating, "Constitutional amendment requires bipartisan agreement," echoing this sentiment. He added, "Historically, there have been cases where a constitutional amendment was pushed through unilaterally, ignoring opposition from the minority party. From the extractive amendment, the arithmetic manipulation amendment, the third-term amendment, to the Yushin Constitution, they all ended in dictatorship and misfortune. What the Democratic Party is doing now is walking the path of dictatorship, insurrection, and anti-freedom, anti-democracy." <<> During the plenary session that day, Speaker Woo criticized the People Power Party, forcefully striking the gavel and even shedding tears. Lawmakers from the People Power Party walked out en masse during Woo’s remarks. Floor Leader Song remarked, "Speaker Woo unilaterally and emotionally proceeded with the plenary session without any bipartisan agreement. Is this the proper state of the National Assembly and the country?" He further criticized, "Proposing a constitutional amendment on their own and then simply asking whether one is for or against it is a highly flawed approach. Are they trying to turn the Constitution into a patchwork of rags?" <<> People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "First, you put on a tearjerking show before the public, then you hammer the parliamentary gavel as if to break it. Speaker Woo must apologize for his arrogance before the people." <<> The People Power Party also raised suspicions that Speaker Woo’s sudden reversal of his plan to hold a revote on the amendment was due to his overseas travel schedule. Speaker Woo, whose term ends on the 29th of this month, is reportedly set to embark on a week-long overseas trip to the Netherlands and Kenya starting on the 10th. After the People Power Party announced its intention to filibuster all 51 agenda items scheduled for the plenary session, Speaker Woo, facing a situation where the session could extend into next month, may have adjourned the plenary to accommodate his overseas schedule. Lawmaker Park Choong-kwon posted on Facebook, "Since the filibuster was thwarted, Speaker Woo can now enjoy his final overseas trip with peace of mind." <<> Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin told reporters, "The People Power Party is not opposed to constitutional amendment. We are opposed to forcefully and unilaterally passing it before the local elections. Our position is to gather opinions together when forming a special committee on constitutional amendment in the latter half of the session (the 22nd National Assembly starting in June)." (국민의힘은 8일 더불어민주당이 주도한 헌법 개정안이 무산된 것과 관련해 “여야 합의 없는 독재 개헌은 기필코 국민과 끝까지 막아내겠다”고 했다. 우원식 국회의장은 이날 국회 본회의를 열어 민주당 주도의 개헌안을 강행 처리하려 했으나 국민의힘 반발에 막히자 “더 이상 상정하지 않겠다. 오늘로써 관련 절차는 중단됐다”고 했다. 이에 따라 6·3 지방선거에서 개헌안의 찬반을 묻는 국민투표는 무산됐다.)

item.title: President Lee Makes Surprise Visit to Namdaemun Market: "Remember Eating Pig Trotters While Preparing for the Bar Exam" (남대문 시장 깜짝 방문한 李대통령 “사시 준비하던 시절 족발 먹었던 기억”)
item.description:
President Lee Makes Surprise Visit to Namdaemun Market: "Remember Eating Pig Trotters While Preparing for the Bar Exam" (남대문 시장 깜짝 방문한 李대통령 “사시 준비하던 시절 족발 먹었던 기억”)

President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung made a surprise visit to Namdaemun Market in Seoul on the 8th. (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 8일 서울 남대문시장을 깜짝 방문했다.)

The presidential couple visited Namdaemun Market in Jung-gu, Seoul, after attending a Parents' Day ceremony earlier that morning. As they entered the market, citizens cheered, saying, "Nice to meet you," "Stay strong," "We're really lucky today," and "Please take a picture with us." Foreign tourists from Malaysia and other countries also showed interest, capturing photos and videos with their smartphones. (이 대통령 부부는 이날 오전 어버이날 기념식 참석을 마친 뒤 서울 중구 남대문시장을 찾았다. 이 대통령 부부가 시장에 들어서자 시민들은 “반갑습니다”, “힘내세요”, “오늘 정말 운이 좋네요”, “사진 한번 찍어주세요”라며 환호했다. 말레이시아 등 외국인 관광객들도 휴대전화로 사진과 영상을 촬영하며 관심을 보였다.)

President Lee asked market vendors how business was going and listened to their on-site opinions. Some vendors said, "The overall economy is tough, but with more foreign tourists, things are livelier than before," and "We need support to attract even more foreign tourists." First Lady Kim also exchanged greetings with the vendors, saying, "I used to come often to the children's clothing section of Namdaemun Market. Coming back after so long, I can still feel the same energy and warmth as before." (이 대통령은 시장 상인들에게 장사가 잘되는지 묻고 현장 의견을 들었다. 일부 상인들은 “경기가 전반적으로 어렵지만 외국인 관광객들이 늘면서 예전보다 활기를 되찾고 있다”, “외국인 관광객들이 더 많이 찾을 수 있도록 지원이 필요하다”고 했다. 김 여사도 상인들과 인사를 나누며 “예전에 남대문시장 아동복 상가에 자주 왔었다”며 “오랜만에 다시 와보니 예전의 활기와 정겨움이 그대로 느껴진다”고 했다.)

According to Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong of the Presidential Office, the couple purchased hats, glasses straps, and dumplings from the market using Onnuri gift vouchers and cash. They also took photos with citizens. Later, the presidential couple had lunch at a pig trotter restaurant inside Namdaemun Market. President Lee recalled a past anecdote, saying, "I remember coming to Namdaemun Market during my bar exam preparation days and enjoying some delicious pig trotters." The lunch was shared with Moon Nam-yeop, the head of the Namdaemun Market Merchants Association. President Lee asked Chairman Moon about the market's atmosphere and facility maintenance conditions, listening to the vendors' difficulties. (안귀령 청와대 부대변인에 따르면 이 대통령 부부는 시장에서 모자와 안경 스트랩, 만두 등을 온누리 상품권과 현금으로 구입했다. 시민들과 사진도 찍었다. 이후 이 대통령 부부는 남대문시장 안 족발집에서 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령은 “사법시험을 준비하던 시절 남대문시장에 와서 족발을 맛있게 먹었던 기억이 있다”며 과거 일화를 떠올렸다. 오찬 자리에는 문남엽 남대문시장 상인회장이 함께했다. 이 대통령은 문 회장에게 시장 분위기와 시설 정비 상황 등을 묻고 상인들의 애로 사항을 들었다.)

After lunch, the presidential couple visited Building C of Namdaemun Market to look around the shops. First Lady Kim examined hairpins, earrings, and necklaces, and purchased some items. Vendors explained to President Lee, "Overseas demand for K-fashion and K-accessories is steadily increasing, to the point where export volumes account for a significant portion of our sales." (이 대통령 부부는 오찬 뒤 남대문시장 C동을 찾아 상점들을 둘러봤다. 김 여사는 머리핀과 귀걸이, 목걸이 등을 살펴본 뒤 일부 상품을 구매했다. 상인들은 이 대통령에게 “수출 물량이 매출의 상당 부분을 차지할 정도로 K패션과 K잡화에 대한 해외 수요가 꾸준히 늘고 있다”고 설명했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Ahn explained the purpose of the visit: "It was intended to encourage small business owners suffering from the economic downturn due to the Middle East situation and other factors, to hear their voices on the ground, and to check on measures to revitalize tourism and traditional markets in line with the recent increase in foreign tourists visiting Korea." (안 부대변인은 이번 방문에 대해 “중동 사태 등에 따른 경기 위축으로 어려움을 겪는 소상공인들을 격려하고 현장의 목소리를 직접 듣는 한편, 최근 외국인 관광객들의 방한 수요 증가에 맞춰 관광과 전통시장 활성화 방안을 점검하기 위한 취지”라고 설명했다.)

item.title: ACI: Former Secretary General Jeong Seung-yoon Met with President Yoon Before Kim Keon-hee Case Closure (권익위 “정승윤 전 사무처장, 김건희 사건 처리 전 尹 만난 정황”)
item.description:
ACI: Former Secretary General Jeong Seung-yoon Met with President Yoon Before Kim Keon-hee Case Closure (권익위 “정승윤 전 사무처장, 김건희 사건 처리 전 尹 만난 정황” )

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) announced on the 8th that it had uncovered evidence that former Secretary General Jeong Seung-yoon, who was involved in handling the case of First Lady Kim Keon-hee receiving a luxury handbag, met with former President Yoon Seok-youl during the case processing period. The ACRC stated that there is a possibility that former Secretary Jeong received an improper request from former President Yoon regarding the handling of the case, and that it would request the National Investigation Headquarters to investigate Jeong. Former Secretary Jeong, who is running for the Busan Superintendent of Education election, protested by shaving his head, calling it "political manipulation." (국민권익위원회가 김건희 여사 명품 가방 수수 사건 처리에 관여한 정승윤 전 사무처장이 사건 처리 기간에 윤석열 전 대통령을 만난 정황을 포착했다고 8일 발표했다. 권익위는 정 전 처장이 윤 전 대통령으로부터 사건 처리에 대해 부정 청탁을 받았을 가능성이 있다며 국가수사본부에 정 전 처장 수사를 의뢰하겠다고 했다. 부산교육감 선거에 출마한 정 전 처장은 “정치 공작”이라고 반발하며 삭발했다.)

In late 2023, the People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy (PSPD) reported to the ACRC that "the First Lady receiving a luxury handbag from Pastor Choi Jae-young, a Korean-American, violated the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act." The PSPD also claimed that former President Yoon's failure to report that the First Lady had received the luxury handbag was also a violation of the Act. (지난 2023년 말 참여연대는 권익위에 ‘김 여사가 재미동포 최재영 목사에게서 명품 가방을 받은 것은 청탁금지법을 어긴 것’이라고 신고했다. 참여연대는 윤 전 대통령이 김 여사가 명품 가방을 받은 사실을 신고하지 않은 것도 청탁금지법 위반이라고 주장했다.)

In response, the ACRC decided in July 2024 to close the case against the First Lady, stating "there is no provision under the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act that allows for sanctions against the spouse of a public official when they receive money or property." Regarding former President Yoon, it also decided to close the case, stating, "If the handbag received by the First Lady was related to the former President's duties, it would be a presidential record and thus not subject to reporting obligations, and if it was unrelated, it would not be a reportable matter in the first place." (이에 대해 권익위는 2024년 7월 ‘청탁금지법상 공직자의 배우자가 금품을 받은 경우 해당 배우자를 제재할 수 있는 조항이 없다’며 김 여사에 대해 종결(무혐의)을 결정했다. 윤 전 대통령에 대해서도 ‘김 여사가 받은 가방이 윤 전 대통령의 직무와 관련이 있다면 대통령기록물이라 신고 의무가 없고, 직무와 관련이 없다면 애초에 신고 대상이 아니다’라며 종결을 결정했다.)

Shortly after Chairman Jeong Il-yeon, appointed by President Lee Jae-myung, assumed office in March, the ACRC formed a "Task Force for the Normalization of the ACRC" to reinvestigate this case. Chairman Jeong announced the results of the reinvestigation on the morning of the 8th at the Government Complex Seoul, stating, "We confirmed that former Secretary Jeong met informally with former President Yoon at the presidential residence on March 18, 2024, which was the 60th day after the case was received." (권익위는 지난 3월 이재명 대통령이 임명한 정일연 위원장이 취임한 직후 ‘권익위 정상화 추진 TF(태스크포스)’를 구성해 이 사건을 재조사했다. 정 위원장은 8일 오전 정부서울청사에서 재조사 결과를 발표하면서 “정 전 처장이 사건 접수 60일이 되는 날인 2024년 3월 18일 관저에서 윤 전 대통령과 비공식적으로 만난 정황을 확인했다”고 했다.)

Chairman Jeong said, "Former Secretary Jeong delayed the processing of the case, personally drafted the resolution that should, in principle, have been written by the responsible department, and in that process, added items not included in the agenda submitted to the (ACRC's) plenary committee, as well as matters not discussed during the meeting." He added, "The investigators' opinions differed," and "It should not have been closed." The implication is that, contrary to the investigators' opinion that the ACRC should not judge whether the First Lady and former President Yoon violated the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act and should hand the case over to another agency, former Secretary Jeong induced the ACRC to close the case on its own. (정 위원장은 “정 전 처장이 사건 처리를 지연시켰고, 원칙적으로 담당 부서가 작성해야 하는 의결서를 직접 작성했고, 그 과정에서 (권익위 전원위원회에) 상정된 의안에 포함되지 않은 사항과, 회의 시 논의되지 않은 사항들을 추가했다”고 말했다. 또 “조사관들의 의견은 달랐다”며 “종결로 처리해서는 안 됐다”고 했다. ‘김 여사와 윤 전 대통령이 청탁금지법을 위반했는지에 대해 권익위가 판단하지 말고 다른 기관으로 넘기자’는 조사관들의 의견과 다르게 정 전 처장이 권익위가 자체적으로 사건을 종결시켜 버리도록 유도했다는 취지다.)

A former Director of the Anti-Corruption Bureau, identified as Kim, who was involved in handling the case, later died by suicide. In this regard, Chairman Jeong said, "We confirmed circumstances where former Secretary Jeong excluded the deceased from speaking at meetings, barred him from work on major cases, and criticized him based on unsubstantiated facts. This appears to constitute workplace harassment." However, Chairman Jeong added, "We closely investigated whether former Secretary Jeong had intent to cause personnel disadvantages to former Director Kim, but found no concrete evidence whatsoever." (사건 처리에 관여했던 김모 전 부패방지국장은 나중에 스스로 목숨을 끊었다. 이와 관련해 정 위원장은 “정 전 처장이 고인에 대해 회의에서 발언권을 배제하고, 주요 사건 관련 업무에서 배제하며, 확실하지 않은 사실을 토대로 비난한 정황이 확인됐다”며 “직장 내 괴롭힘에 해당할 것으로 보인다”고 했다. 정 위원장은 다만 “정 전 처장이 김 전 국장에게 인사상 불이익을 주려는 의도가 있었는지를 면밀히 조사했는데, 구체적인 증거를 전혀 발견하지 못했다”고 했다.)

Despite this, the ACRC decided to maintain the existing "closure" conclusion on this case. (권익위는 그러면서도 이 사건에 대한 기존 ‘종결’ 결론은 유지하기로 했다.)

At a press conference at the Busan City Council that afternoon, former Secretary Jeong stated, "The ACRC's announcement is a one-sided condemnation and distortion of facts," and called it "political manipulation ahead of the Busan Superintendent of Education election." (정 전 처장은 이날 오후 부산시의회 기자회견에서 “권익위의 발표는 일방적인 매도와 사실 왜곡”이라며 “부산교육감 선거를 앞두고 진행되고 있는 정치 공작”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the ACRC's announcement that there was a possibility he had received an improper request from former President Yoon about the case handling, former Secretary Jeong said, "Even after this case was received, I attended State Council meetings during my tenure as acting ACRC chairman, and I frequently visited the presidential office for work as the Secretary General. The claim that I met with the president at night to discuss something not urgent is absurd." (정 전 처장은 그가 윤 전 대통령으로부터 사건 처리에 관해 부정 청탁을 받았을 가능성이 있다는 권익위 발표에 대해 “이 사건 접수 이후에도 저는 권익위원장 직무대리 기간 국무회의에 참석했고, 사무처장으로서 업무차 대통령실을 수시로 방문했다”며 “시급을 요하지도 않는 일로 야간에 대통령을 만나 의논했다는 식의 주장에는 헛웃음이 나올 뿐”이라고 했다.)

On the ACRC's statement that he had induced the "closure" conclusion, he said, "Accepting money or property should rightfully be subject to moral and political criticism, but the ACRC is a law enforcement agency. The TF's judgment to maintain the closure conclusion is extremely common-sense and natural." He added, "This case was concluded by a vote of 15 plenary committee members, and the decision document was also processed by the plenary committee. The case was handled transparently in accordance with regulations and procedures." (정 전 처장이 ‘종결’ 결론을 유도했다는 취지의 권익위 발표에 대해서는 “금품 수수는 도덕적·정치적 비난 대상이 되어야 마땅하지만, 권익위는 법 집행 기관”이라며 “종결 결론을 유지한다는 권익위 TF의 판단은 지극히 상식적이고 당연한 결론”이라고 했다. 또 “이 사건은 전원위원회 위원 15명의 표결로 결론이 도출됐고, 결정문도 전원위에서 처리된 것”이라며 “사건은 규정과 절차에 따라 투명하게 처리됐다”고 했다.)

In response to the ACRC's announcement that he had harassed former Director Kim, he said, "I gave the deceased key positions such as head of the Operations Support Division and acting dedicated director of the Anti-Corruption Bureau, showing my special trust and confidence in him. Claims like 'there was conflict,' 'he was excluded from work,' or 'I publicly criticized him' are all fiction." (김 전 국장을 괴롭혔다는 권익위 발표에 대해서는 “고인에게 핵심 보직인 운영지원과장과 부패방지국장 전담 직무대리를 맡겼을 정도로 고인에 대한 신임과 신뢰가 각별했다”며 “‘갈등이 있었다’ ‘업무에서 배제했다’ ‘공개적으로 비난했다’는 식의 주장은 모두 소설”이라고 했다.)

Former Secretary Jeong then shaved his head on the spot, stating, "They are pinning a crime on the 'Kim Keon-hee luxury handbag' case while burying the 'Jeon Jae-soo (Democratic Party candidate for Busan Mayor) luxury watch' case, where punishment clauses clearly exist. I will resist state violence where the law has degenerated into a tool to attack the opposition." (정 전 처장은 “‘김건희 명품 가방’ 사건에는 죄를 뒤집어씌우고, 처벌 조문이 명백히 존재하는 ‘전재수(더불어민주당 부산시장 후보) 명품 시계’ 사건은 묻어버리고 있다. 법이 반대편을 공격하는 도구로 전락한 국가 폭력에 항거하겠다”며 즉석에서 삭발을 했다.)

item.title: Intensifying Gyeongnam Governor Election: Legal Actions and Policy Plagiarism Allegations (격해지는 경남지사 선거전… 법적 대응에 정책 표절 시비까지)
item.description:
Intensifying Gyeongnam Governor Election: Legal Actions and Policy Plagiarism Allegations (격해지는 경남지사 선거전… 법적 대응에 정책 표절 시비까지)

The race for the Gyeongnam Province governor ahead of the June 3 local elections is heating up. The campaign of Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo has taken legal action over the visual representation of poll results, while the camp of People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo criticized Kim’s welfare pledges, accusing him of “riding on” Park’s Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension policy. (6·3 지방선거를 앞둔 경남도지사 선거전이 격화되고 있다. 여론조사 결과의 시각적 표현 방식을 두고 더불어민주당 김경수 후보 측이 법적 대응에 나섰고, 국민의힘 박완수 후보 캠프에서는 김 후보의 복지 공약에 대해 “박완수 지사 경남도민연금 정책에 숟가락을 얹는다”고 비판했다.)

The legal support team for Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo announced on the 8th that it had filed a complaint with the Gyeongnam Provincial Police Agency regarding the way People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo’s side has been citing poll results. (민주당 김경수 후보 캠프 법률지원단은 8일 박완수 국민의힘 후보 측의 여론조사 결과 인용 방식과 관련해 경남경찰청에 고발장을 제출했다고 밝혔다.)

Kim’s camp claimed that the graphs used in Park’s campaign materials to display poll results were not proportional to the actual figures, raising concerns that they could distort public sentiment in favor of a specific candidate. (김 후보 측은 박 후보의 선거 홍보물에 사용된 여론조사 결과 그래프가 실제 수치와 비례하지 않게 제작돼 특정 후보에게 유리하도록 민심을 왜곡할 우려가 크다고 주장했다.)

It was reported that a review was conducted on whether this violates Article 96 of the Public Official Election Act (prohibition on distorting poll results). The legal support team emphasized, “Poll results go beyond merely presenting numbers; visual expressions directly influence voters’ judgments. If the proportions or composition of graphs make the actual gap appear exaggerated or minimized, it may constitute a violation of relevant laws.” (공직선거법 제96조(여론조사 결과 왜곡 공표 금지) 위반 여부를 검토한 것으로 전해졌다. 법률지원단은 “여론조사 결과는 단순한 수치 제시에 그치지 않고 시각적 표현을 통해 유권자 판단에 직접적인 영향을 미친다”며 “그래프의 비율이나 구성 방식이 실제 격차보다 과장되거나 축소돼 보이도록 하는 경우 관련 법령 위반에 해당할 수 있다”고 강조했다.)

Kim’s campaign has launched a legal support team of about 20 lawyers, including former judges and prosecutors, headed by lawyer Ha Gwi-nam, a former politician. Ha Gwi-nam, the head of the legal support team, stated, “We will fulfill our responsibility to the end so that this election is evaluated based on policies and visions, not falsehoods and distortions.” (김 후보 캠프는 정치인 출신의 하귀남 변호사를 총괄단장으로, 판·검사 출신 등 변호사 20여 명의 법률지원단을 발족했다. 하귀남 법률지원총괄단장은 “허위와 왜곡이 아닌 정책과 비전으로 평가받는 선거가 될 수 있도록 끝까지 책임을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

In response, Park’s camp retorted, “We have complied with the standards required by election law. If there are disagreements over the graph expressions, it would be appropriate to verify them through the election commission. This is not a legitimate raising of issues based on election law but a low-level response attempting to cover up unfavorable public sentiment with a complaint framework.” (이에 박 후보 캠프에서는 “선거법상 요구되는 기준을 준수해왔고, 그래프 표현 방식에 대해 이견이 있다면 선관위에 확인절차를 통해 따져보면 될 일”이라며 “선거법을 앞세운 정당한 문제 제기라기보다, 불리한 민심 흐름을 고발 프레임으로 덮으려는 저급한 대응”이라고 반박했다.)

On the same day, Park’s camp criticized the ‘Five Major Aging Security Pledges’ announced by Kim. (박 후보 캠프에서는 이날 김 후보가 발표한 ‘노후 안심 5대 공약’에 대해 비판했다.)

Kim announced a pledge to expand the maximum support amount for the Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension for low-income residents to 50,000 won. (김 후보는 이날 저소득층 대상 경남도민연금 지원액을 최대 5만원까지 확대하겠다는 내용의 공약을 발표했다.)

In response, Park’s side criticized the pledge, stating that it was based on the ‘Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension’ policy promoted by incumbent governor Park Wan-soo during his term, calling it “riding on the spoon.” (이에 박 후보 측은 해당 공약이 현직인 박완수 후보가 도지사 재임 중 추진한 ‘경남도민연금’ 정책을 기반으로 한 것으로 “숟가락 얹기”라고 비판했다.)

The Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension is a system introduced by Gyeongnam Province this year to bridge the income gap that occurs after retirement until the receipt of the national pension. (경남도민연금은 은퇴 후 국민연금 수급 전까지 발생하는 소득 공백을 메우고자 경남도가 올해부터 도입한 제도다.)

If a subscriber pays 80,000 won per month for 10 years, totaling 9.6 million won, the province and city/county add a subsidy of 2.4 million won and 2% interest, accumulating about 13.02 million won. Then, starting at age 60 or after 10 years of enrollment, they receive 217,000 won per month for five years as a pension. The previous recruitment period saw high interest and was closed early. (가입자가 월 8만원씩 10년간 960만원을 내면 도와 시·군 지원금 240만원과 이자 2%가 더해져 약 1302만원이 적립된다. 이후 만 60세 또는 가입 10년 경과 시점부터 5년간 매월 21만7000원을 연금 형태로 받는다. 지난 모집 과정에서 높은 관심 속에 조기 마감됐다.)

Park’s camp criticized, “The Democratic Party’s think tank, the Democratic Research Institute, criticized this policy earlier this year, stating it had a structural limitation excluding low-income groups. When criticizing, they pushed the Democratic Research Institute report, but once the policy became popular, Kim Kyoung-soo jumped on board.” (박 후보 측은 “민주당 싱크탱크인 민주연구원은 올해 초 해당 정책을 두고 ‘저소득층은 배제되는 구조적 한계가 있다’는 취지로 비판했었다”며 “비판할 때는 민주연구원 보고서를 앞세우고, 인기가 확인되니 김경수 후보가 뒤따라 올라탄 꼴”이라고 비판했다.)

They argued that it is inconsistent to raise issues during the policy’s introduction and now propose expanding support for the same policy. (도입 때는 문제를 제기해 놓고, 이제 와서 같은 정책의 지원 규모를 확대하겠다고 나선 것은 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다는 것이다.)

Meanwhile, ahead of Parents’ Day, both sides have been rolling out aging-related pledges. Kim announced the ‘Five Major Aging Security Pledges,’ focusing on income security and strengthening medical and welfare safety nets. He pledged to pursue ‘Absolute Poverty Zero’ by adding additional support from Gyeongnam Province to the basic livelihood security recipients’ living expenses, guaranteeing income at least at 40% of the median income. He also announced full support for health insurance premiums for low-income individuals aged 60-64 who face an income gap between retirement and receiving the national pension. This plan aims to simultaneously alleviate the burden of medical costs and income loss after retirement. He also stated that the Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension, implemented this year, will expand support for low-income groups up to 50,000 won per month based on income level. (한편, 어버이날을 맞아 양측은 노후 관련 공약을 잇따라 냈다. 김 후보는 소득 보장과 의료·복지 안전망 강화에 초점을 둔 ‘노후 안심 5대 공약’을 발표했다. 기초생활수급자 생계급여에 경남도의 추가 지원을 더해 최소 중위소득 40% 수준까지 소득을 보장하는 ‘절대빈곤 제로화’를 추진하겠다고 했다. 퇴직 후 국민연금을 받기 전까지 소득 공백이 발생하는 60~64세 저소득층을 대상으로 건강보험료를 전액 지원하겠다고 밝혔다. 은퇴 이후 의료비 부담과 소득 단절 문제를 동시에 완화하겠다는 구상이다. 올해 시행된 경남도민연금도 소득 수준에 따라 저소득층에 월 최대 5만원까지 지원을 확대하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Park announced an ‘Active Aging’ policy centered on expanding senior jobs and leisure/cultural support. He pledged to expand senior jobs from the current 75,000 to 100,000 starting next year. He also plans to expand the grandchild care support project. Currently, support of 200,000 won per month is provided for households with income at 150% or less of the median income and children under 2 years old if they provide more than 40 hours of care per month. He said he would ease income standards and the age of eligible children. (박 후보는 노인 일자리와 여가·문화 지원 확대를 중심으로 ‘활기찬 노후’ 정책을 발표했다. 노인 일자리를 현재 7만5000개 수준에서 내년부터 10만개까지 확대하겠다고 했다. 손주 돌봄 지원 사업도 늘린다. 현재 중위소득 150% 이하 가구·만 2세 영아를 대상으로 월 40시간 이상 돌봄을 하면 월 20만원을 지원하는데, 소득 기준과 지원 대상 아동 연령 등을 완화하겠다고 했다.)

He also promised to gradually increase the operational costs for 7,695 senior centers across the province to up to 200,000 won per month per center starting next year. (내년부터 도내 경로당 7695곳의 운영비를 한 곳당 월 20만원까지 단계적으로 올리겠다고도 약속했다.)

Progressive Party governor candidate Jeon Hee-young also announced welfare pledges for a ‘Gyeongnam without aging worries.’ She proposed a phased introduction of a ‘Gyeongnam Senior Allowance’ for low-income elderly individuals struggling on the basic pension alone. She pledged to expand public senior jobs and adjust wages to realistic levels. Along with a public-led integrated care system, she also proposed expanding public medical infrastructure by region. (진보당 전희영 도지사 후보도 ‘노후 걱정 없이 살기 좋은 경남’을 위한 복지 공약을 발표했다. 기초연금만으로 생활이 어려운 저소득 어르신을 대상으로 한 ‘경남 어르신 수당’을 단계적으로 지급하겠다고 했다. 공공 노인 일자리를 확대하고 임금도 현실화하겠다고 약속했다. 공공이 주도하는 통합 돌봄 체계와 함께 권역별 공공 의료 기반 확충도 제시했다.)

item.title: Main Opposition Party Nominates Kim Young-bin for By-election in Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, Chungnam… Wrapping Up Nominations for 14 Districts (與, 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐에 김영빈 공천…14곳 공천 마무리)
item.description:
Main Opposition Party Nominates Kim Young-bin for By-election in Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, Chungnam… Wrapping Up Nominations for 14 Districts (與, 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐에 김영빈 공천…14곳 공천 마무리)

The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 8th that it would strategically nominate attorney Kim Young-bin for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, Chungcheongnam-do, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections. This completes the party's nominations for by-elections in 14 constituencies. (더불어민주당은 6·3 지방선거와 같이 치러지는 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거에 김영빈 변호사를 전략 공천한다고 8일 밝혔다. 이로써 민주당의 14개 지역구 재보선 공천은 마무리됐다.)

Attorney Kim, a native of Gongju, Chungnam, graduated from Korea University's law school and is a member of the 37th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute. He began his career as a prosecutor at the Incheon District Prosecutors' Office and later worked at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office and the Office of the Minister of Justice's Policy Advisor, among other positions. (김 변호사는 충남 공주 출신으로 고려대 법대를 졸업했으며 사법연수원 37기다. 인천지검에서 검사 생활을 시작해 서울중앙지검과 법무부 장관 정책보좌관실 등에서 일했다.)

On this day, party leader Jeong Cheong-rae introduced Attorney Kim at a recruitment event for electoral talents, stating, "He is a person of Gongju and Chungcheong-do through and through," adding, "I am truly delighted that he has stepped forward to apply the administrative experience and capabilities he gained at the prosecution and the Ministry of Justice to the development of Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang." (정청래 대표는 이날 선거 인재 영입식에서 김 변호사를 소개하며 “뼛속까지 공주 사람이자 충청도 사람”이라며 “검찰과 법무부에서 쌓은 행정 경험과 역량을 이제는 공주·부여·청양의 발전을 위해 쓰겠다고 나서줘서 정말 기쁘다”고 했다.)

Attorney Kim said, "I will repay the grace of my hometown and the trust of the Democratic Party, which has embraced me, with my whole being," and added, "I will now begin the great first step toward the greater leap of Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, with the prepared Kim Young-bin's fresh perspective in his 40s." (김 변호사는 “고향의 은혜와 저를 안아준 민주당의 믿음에 온몸을 맞춰 보답하겠다”며 “준비된 김영빈이 새로운 40대의 시선으로 공주·부여·청양의 더 큰 도약을 향한 위대한 첫걸음을 지금 시작하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Replacement process underway for candidate who defended child sex offenders... Ruling party designates Gangbuk-gu mayoral election as strategic district (‘아동 성범죄 변호’ 후보 교체 수순… 與 강북구청장 전략선거구 지정)
item.description:
Replacement process underway for candidate who defended child sex offenders... Ruling party designates Gangbuk-gu mayoral election as strategic district (‘아동 성범죄 변호’ 후보 교체 수순… 與 강북구청장 전략선거구 지정)

The Democratic Party of Korea has designated the Seoul Gangbuk-gu mayoral election district as a strategic district. This move comes after Lee Seung-hoon, the winner of the primary, became embroiled in controversy over his past record, prompting a candidate replacement process. In relation to this, some within the party argue that "local lawmakers should not exert influence over the nomination of district mayors." (더불어민주당이 서울 강북구청장 선거구를 전략선거구로 지정했다. 경선에서 승리한 이승훈 후보가 과거 이력으로 논란에 휩싸이자 후보 교체 수순에 나선 것이다. 이와 관련해 당내에서 “지역구 국회의원이 구청장 공천에 영향력을 행사하면 안 된다”는 주장이 나왔다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Park Ji-hye told reporters after a Supreme Council meeting on the 8th regarding the Gangbuk-gu mayoral candidate, "The relevant district was designated as a strategic district at last evening's (the 7th) Supreme Council meeting," adding, "The Strategic Nomination Management Committee will decide how to proceed with the candidate selection." (박지혜 민주당 대변인은 8일 최고위원회의를 마치고 기자들과 만나 강북구청장 후보와 관련해 “해당 선거구를 어제(7일) 저녁 최고위에서 전략선거구로 지정했다”며 “후보 결정과 관련해 전략공천관리위원회에서 어떻게 진행할지 결정할 예정”이라고 했다.)

While Lee's eligibility has not been revoked, this is interpreted as effectively a step toward candidate replacement. Spokesperson Park said, "The Strategic Nomination Management Committee will decide whether to hold a primary among existing candidates or to strategically nominate a new candidate." (이 후보의 자격이 박탈된 것은 아니지만, 사실상 후보 교체 수순으로 해석됐다. 박 대변인은 “전략공관위에서 기존 후보를 대상으로 경선하게 될지, 새로운 후보를 전략공천하게 될지 결정할 것”이라고 했다.)

It is reported that during the Supreme Council meeting, concerns were raised about the inappropriateness of Lee's history of defending perpetrators of child sex offenses and operators of sex trade businesses in the Gangbuk area during his career as a lawyer. (최고위에서는 이 후보가 변호사로 활동하면서 아동 성범죄 사건 가해자와 강북구 일대 성매매 영업 사건 가해자 등을 변호한 이력을 놓고 부적절하다는 지적이 나온 것으로 전해졌다.)

In response, Kim Ki-ok, head of the Kim Dae-jung Foundation's Gangbuk branch and a former Seoul city council member from Gangbuk-gu, said in a text message distributed to local residents on the same day, "The Supreme Council's designation of a strategic district is ultimately an admission that the previous nomination was flawed," adding, "Those responsible for this nomination fiasco remain silent." (이에 대해 강북구에서 서울시의원을 지낸 김기옥 김대중재단 강북지회장은 이날 지역민에게 배포한 문자에서 “민주당 최고위의 전략선거구 지정은 결국 지난 공천이 잘못됐음을 자인한 결과”라며 “공천 참사를 초래한 장본인들은 여전히 침묵하고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim claimed, "Lawmakers Cheon Jun-ho and Han Min-su, who distorted public sentiment by biasedly supporting a specific candidate during the primary process, have not uttered a single apology to the residents." Rep. Cheon represents Gangbuk-gu's district A, and Rep. Han represents district B. Kim argued, "Those who should take responsibility for the failed nomination are once again hiding behind the name of 'strategic nomination' to exert behind-the-scenes influence." He then stated, "I strongly urge the Strategic Nomination Management Committee to thoroughly block the private interference of these two lawmakers." (김 지회장은 “경선 과정에서 특정 후보를 편파적으로 지원하며 민심을 왜곡했던 천준호·한민수 두 국회의원은 구민 앞에 단 한 마디 사과조차 없다”고 주장했다. 천 의원은 서울 강북갑, 한 의원은 강북을 현역 의원이다. 김 지회장은 “실패한 공천에 책임을 져야 할 이들이 또다시 ‘전략 공천’이라는 이름 뒤에 숨어 막후에서 영향력을 행사하려 한다”고 주장했다. 그는 그러면서 “전략공관위에 강력히 요구한다. 두 의원의 사적인 입김을 철저히 차단하라”고 했다.)

Choi Sun, a preliminary candidate for Gangbuk-gu mayor who competed against Lee Seung-hoon in the primary, had previously claimed that the two lawmakers intervened in the primary by supporting Lee. However, both lawmakers denied these allegations, and the party's election committee reportedly concluded that there was no issue. (이승훈 후보와 경선에서 경쟁했던 최선 강북구청장 예비후보 측은 두 의원이 이 후보를 지지하는 등 경선에 개입했다고 주장한 바 있다. 그러나 두 의원 측은 이러한 주장에 대해 부인했고, 민주당 선관위에선 문제가 없다고 결론 내린 것으로 알려졌다.)

Following the expulsion of lawmakers Kim Byung-ki and Kang Sun-woo due to a nomination bribery scandal during the last local elections, the Democratic Party has largely excluded incumbent lawmakers from participating in nomination-related bodies for this local election. The party also issued guidelines prohibiting lawmakers from serving as honorary chairs of support groups for preliminary candidates in their regions. (민주당은 지난 지방선거 때 벌어진 공천 돈 거래 사건으로 김병기·강선우 의원이 제명당한 뒤 이번 지방선거에선 현역 의원의 공천 관련 기구 참여를 최대한 배제했다. 민주당은 의원들에게 지역 예비후보 후원회장을 맡지 말라는 지침을 내리기도 했다.)

item.description:
National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee Plans Inspection Trip to Shanghai, China from 10th to 13th, "To Grasp Status of High-Tech Industries" (국회 법사위, 10~13일 중국 상하이 시찰 예정 “첨단 산업 현황 파악”)

The National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee is promoting a visit to Shanghai, China from the 10th, with a schedule of 3 nights and 4 days. (국회 법제사법위원회가 오는 10일부터 3박 4일 일정으로 중국 상하이 방문을 추진한다.)

According to the overseas inspection plan of the Legislative and Judiciary Committee released on the 8th, committee members will visit Shanghai, China from the 10th to the 13th to understand the operational status of judicial institutions such as Chinese arbitration and mediation bodies, as well as the current state of China's high-tech industries and related systems. item.title: North Korea Unveils New Self-Propelled Howitzer Capable of Striking All of Seoul (北, 서울 전역 때릴 ‘신형 자주포’ 꺼냈다)
item.description:
North Korea Unveils New Self-Propelled Howitzer Capable of Striking All of Seoul (北, 서울 전역 때릴 ‘신형 자주포’ 꺼냈다)

North Korea announced on the 8th that it will deploy new self-propelled howitzers with a range of over 60 km, capable of striking all of Seoul, to the "southern border" this year. Following the establishment of a "territorial clause" in its revised constitution in March, which effectively designates the inter-Korean Military Demarcation Line as the border, this move is seen as intensifying military threats against the Seoul metropolitan area. <<> The Korean Central News Agency reported today that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un visited a key munitions factory on the 6th to inspect the production status of new 155mm self-propelled howitzers planned for deployment to three long-range artillery battalions on the "southern border" this year. The agency quoted Kim as saying, "The range now exceeds 60 km." <<> It remains unclear whether North Korea's claim that the new 155mm self-propelled howitzer has a range of over 60 km is accurate. South Korea's flagship K9 self-propelled howitzer, which has surpassed cumulative export sales of 14 trillion won, typically has a range of about 40 km. Although the K9's caliber is also 155 mm, the same as North Korea's new howitzer, it is known to fall short of 60 km even when using extended-range ammunition. <<> If North Korea's claim is true, it could place the entire Seoul area and parts of southern Gyeonggi Province within striking distance from near the Military Demarcation Line. North Korea's older 152 mm self-propelled howitzers are known to have a range of about 20 km, meaning the range has more than tripled. <<> Shin Jong-woo, Secretary-General of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "The new self-propelled howitzer appears to be equipped with an automated fire control system that automatically aims once target coordinates are input," adding, "This signifies that North Korean artillery capabilities targeting our Seoul metropolitan area have been strengthened." <<> Meanwhile, former U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell said on the 7th (local time) that President Trump is "constantly seeking ways to convey his message to Kim Jong Un." Speaking to reporters in Washington, D.C., Campbell said, "I think President Trump, who will visit China on the 14th and 15th, will seek advice from Chinese President Xi Jinping on how to engage with Kim Jong Un." (북한이 서울 전역을 타격할 수 있는 사거리 60㎞ 이상의 신형 자주포를 올해 ‘남부 국경’에 배치하겠다고 8일 밝혔다. 지난 3월 개정한 헌법에 남북 간 군사분계선을 사실상 국경선으로 규정하는 ‘영토 조항’을 신설한 데 이어, 수도권에 대한 군사 위협도 강화하고 있다는 분석이 나온다.)

item.title: Japan's Takaiichi pushes for Andong visit on 19th (日 다카이치, 19일 안동 방문 추진)
item.description:
Japan's Takaiichi pushes for Andong visit on 19th (日 다카이치, 19일 안동 방문 추진)

Japanese Prime Minister Takaiichi Sanae will visit South Korea this month as part of shuttle diplomacy between the two countries. According to multiple Japanese diplomatic sources on the 8th, Takaiichi is coordinating a schedule to visit Andong, Gyeongbuk, the hometown of President Lee Jae-myung, on the 19th-20th for a summit. If the meeting materializes, it will be the third encounter between President Lee and Prime Minister Takaiichi. The two first met at the APEC summit in Gyeongju last October, and in January this year, President Lee visited Nara Prefecture, Takaiichi’s hometown. (다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 이달 넷째 주 한일 셔틀 외교 일환으로 한국을 방문한다. 8일 복수의 일본 외교 소식통에 따르면, 다카이치 총리는 19~20일 이재명 대통령의 고향인 경북 안동을 방문해 정상회담을 갖는 일정을 조율 중이다. 회담이 성사되면 이 대통령과 다카이치 총리의 세 번째 만남이 된다. 두 사람은 지난해 10월 경주 APEC 회의에서 처음 만났고, 올해 1월엔 이 대통령이 다카이치 총리의 고향인 나라현을 방문했다.)

The upcoming summit is expected to continue fostering personal ties between the leaders while discussing supply chain issues due to the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, North Korea's nuclear and missile problems, and other Northeast Asian security situations. Strengthening security cooperation between South Korea and Japan in response to U.S. demands for allies to share defense burdens is likely to be a key agenda item. The outcome of the U.S.-China summit (14th-15th) is also expected to be discussed. (이번 회담에선 정상 간 친분을 이어가면서 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄로 인한 공급망 문제, 북한의 핵·미사일 문제 등 동북아 정세를 논의할 예정이다. 동맹들에 방위 분담을 요구하는 미국에 대응해 한일 간 안보 협력을 강화하는 방안도 주요 의제가 될 것으로 보인다. 미중 정상회담(14~15일) 결과도 논의될 전망이다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee spoke by phone with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the 8th, agreeing to closely cooperate on guaranteeing freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and ensuring stable energy supply amid the energy and supply chain crisis caused by the Middle East war. (한편 이 대통령은 8일 마크 카니 캐나다 총리와 통화하고, 중동 전쟁으로 인한 에너지·공급망 위기에서 호르무즈 해협 항행의 자유 보장, 안정적 에너지 수급을 위해 긴밀히 협력해 나가기로 했다.)

The phone call between the leaders came as a consortium of Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries competes with Germany's TKMS for a contract worth up to 60 trillion won under Canada's "Canadian Patrol Submarine Project (CPSP)." The results of the bidding are expected as early as the end of next month. A Cheong Wa Dae official said, "Given the enormous scale of the project and intense government-level competition, President Lee lent his support." Earlier, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik visited Canada in January as a special envoy for strategic economic cooperation, and Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-gwan visited Canada on the 5th-6th (local time) to meet with relevant ministry officials. (이날 정상 간 통화는 캐나다가 추진하는 최대 60조원 규모 ‘캐나다 초계 잠수함 프로젝트(CPSP)’ 수주를 놓고 한화오션·HD현대중공업 컨소시엄이 독일 TKMS와 경쟁 중인 가운데 이뤄졌다. 수주전 결과는 이르면 다음 달 말 나올 예정이다. 청와대 관계자는 “워낙 규모가 큰 사업이고 정부 차원의 경쟁도 치열한 상황이어서 이 대통령이 힘을 보탠 것”이라고 했다. 앞서 강훈식 비서실장도 지난 1월 전략경제협력 대통령 특사 자격으로 캐나다를 방문했고, 김정관 산업통상부 장관은 지난 5~6일(현지 시각) 캐나다를 찾아 관계 부처 장관 등을 만났다.)

item.title: “I’m a Pragmatic Pro-Lee… Kim Young-hwan Ended with the Osong Disaster” (“난 실용적 친명… 김영환, 오송 참사 때 끝나”)
item.description:
“I’m a Pragmatic Pro-Lee… Kim Young-hwan Ended with the Osong Disaster” (“난 실용적 친명… 김영환, 오송 참사 때 끝나”)

Shin Yong-han, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Chungcheongbuk-do governor, said on the 7th, “Chungbuk stands at a crossroads between regressing to the past and advancing to the future,” adding, “I will open an era of Chungbuk-led growth.” Candidate Shin joined the Democratic Party in 2024 after being in the conservative camp and served as the vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee for Regional Development after the presidential election. Describing himself as ‘pro-Lee,’ he stated, “The part I most want to emulate from President Lee Jae-myung is his pragmatic code,” and he vowed, “I will create a completely new Chungbuk through policies focused on people’s livelihoods and pragmatism, not on factions or ideology.” (더불어민주당 신용한 충북지사 후보는 지난 7일 “충북은 과거로 퇴행할지, 미래로 전진할지 갈림길에 서 있다”며 “충북 주도 성장 시대를 열겠다”고 했다. 신 후보는 보수 진영에 있다가 2024년 민주당에 합류했고, 대선 후 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 부위원장을 지냈다. 자신을 ‘친명’이라고 평가한 그는 “이재명 대통령과 가장 닮고자 하는 부분은 실용 코드”라며 “정파나 이념이 아니라 민생과 실용주의 정책으로 완전히 새로운 충북을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the People Power Party’s incumbent candidate Kim Young-hwan, who is running for re-election, Candidate Shin said, “What matters is not the number of signed MOUs for investment attraction but actual results; there has been a lack of tangible change for residents across the provincial administration.” He also mentioned the response to the 2023 Cheongju Osong disaster in Chungbuk, saying, “Wouldn’t you say the assessment that (Candidate Kim) lacked the leadership and communication skills of a public servant is already settled?” (신 후보는 재선에 나선 국민의힘 김영환 후보에 대해 “투자 유치 MOU(양해 각서) 숫자보다 실제 결과가 중요하고, 도정 전반에서 도민 체감 변화가 부족했다”고 했다. 또 2023년 충북 청주 오송 참사 대응을 언급하며 “(김 후보가) 섬기는 리더십과 소통 능력이 부족했다는 평가가 이미 끝난 것 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

-You joined the Democratic Party after being in a conservative party. (-보수 정당에 있다가 민주당으로 합류했다.)

“When President Lee Jae-myung was the leader of the Democratic Party, he personally recruited me, saying I was a ‘talent who would broaden the Democratic Party’s scope.’ He recruited me from a pragmatic perspective, seeing my background as the youth committee chair under the Park Geun-hye administration and my experience as an economic news anchor. Indeed, President Lee also governs with a pragmatic focus, not getting bogged down by ideological lines. For me too, the part I most want to emulate is that pragmatic code. Some attack me by calling me ‘Myung-pick,’ but to me, it’s like an honorable badge.” (“이재명 대통령이 민주당 당대표 시절 저를 영입하면서 ‘민주당의 외연을 넓혀줄 인재’라고 직접 말했다. 박근혜 정부에서 청년위원장을 했던 이력, 경제방송 앵커 경력 등을 보고 실용적 관점에서 영입한 것이다. 실제 이 대통령도 이념 노선에 매몰되지 않고 실용 중심 국정을 하지 않나. 저 역시 가장 닮고자 하는 부분이 그 실용 코드다. 일부에서 ‘명픽’이라고 공격하지만, 저에겐 영광스러운 훈장 같은 말이다.”)

-How would you evaluate the four years of Governor Kim Young-hwan’s administration? (-김영환 후보 도정 4년을 평가한다면.)

“He often emphasizes economic achievements, talking about 80 trillion won or 100 trillion won in investment attraction. But the key is not the numbers in MOUs but whether they led to actual investment. The lack of communication and controversy over leadership revealed during the response to the Osong disaster were major disappointments for residents. The starting point of modern administration is communication, and yet an image of uncommunicativeness has already been strongly imprinted. Of course, I’m not saying there were no achievements at all. Areas like raising the birth rate had significance.” (“경제 성과를 강조하며 투자 유치 80조원, 100조원 이야기를 많이 한다. 그런데 중요한 것은 MOU상의 숫자가 아니라 실제 투자로 이어졌는지 여부다. 오송 참사 대응 과정에서 드러난 소통 부재와 리더십 논란은 도민들이 크게 실망한 부분이다. 현대 행정의 출발점은 소통인데 이미 불통 이미지가 강하게 각인돼 있다. 물론 성과가 전혀 없었다는 건 아니다. 출산율 제고 같은 부분은 의미가 있었다.”)

-What is the most urgent task in Chungbuk? (-충북에서 가장 시급한 과제는 무엇인가.)

“The disparity between Cheongju and Chungju, population decline, and the outflow of young people all ultimately connect to the lack of quality jobs and settlement conditions. Chungbuk has a strong manufacturing base in semiconductors, secondary batteries, and biotechnology, but the startup ecosystem to nurture these into future growth companies is weak. We need to transform the manufacturing-centered economy into an AI and digital-based innovative startup economy. I will also address the ‘ER crisis’ as soon as possible. The recent incident in Chungbuk where a fetus died was a symbolic event showing the collapse of essential medical care in the province. The death rate for emergency patients is much higher than in the capital area, and the outflow of critically ill patients is severe. I will introduce an AI-based real-time emergency medical control system to automatically match beds and specialists, and secure essential medical personnel through a regional doctor system tailored to Chungbuk.” (“청주·충주 격차, 인구 감소, 청년 유출 문제 모두 결국 좋은 일자리와 정주 여건 부족으로 연결된다. 충북은 반도체·이차전지·바이오 같은 강한 제조 기반은 갖췄지만, 이를 미래 성장 기업으로 키워낼 창업 생태계는 약하다. 제조업 중심 경제를 AI·디지털 기반 혁신 창업 경제로 전환해야 한다. ‘응급실 뺑뺑이’ 문제도 하루빨리 손보겠다. 최근 충북에서 태아가 사망한 사건은 충북 필수 의료 체계 붕괴를 보여준 상징적 사건이었다. 응급환자 사망률이 수도권보다 훨씬 높고 중증 환자 유출도 심각하다. AI 기반 실시간 응급의료 관제 시스템을 도입해 병상과 전문의를 자동 매칭하고, 충북형 지역의사제를 통해 필수 의료 인력을 확보하겠다.”)

-‘Chungbuk, a Special Startup Province’ is a pledge. (-‘창업특별도 충북’이 공약이다.)

“I will create a 2000 billion won startup fund for Chungbuk and focus on fostering tech startups linked to semiconductors, secondary batteries, and biotechnology. I also plan to establish a ‘second chance’ system so people can try again even after failure. I will actively push for the relocation of secondary public institutions. I aim to attract public institutions in aviation, energy, environment, finance, and biotechnology fields linked to Chungbuk’s industries. Public institutions are not just about relocating buildings; they are anchor institutions that bring jobs, consumption, and research functions together.” (“충북 창업펀드 2000억원을 조성하고 반도체·이차전지·바이오와 연계한 기술 창업을 집중 육성하겠다. 실패해도 다시 도전할 수 있는 ‘패자부활전’ 시스템도 만들 생각이다. 2차 공공기관 이전도 적극 추진하겠다. 항공·에너지·환경·금융·바이오 분야 공공기관을 충북 산업과 연계해 유치할 생각이다. 공공기관은 단순한 건물 이전이 아니라 일자리와 소비, 연구 기능까지 함께 가져오는 앵커 기관이다.”)

-Your stance on the Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong, and North Chungcheong megacity plan? (-대전·세종·충남·충북 메가시티 구상에 대한 입장은.)

“I agree with the big picture. The Chungcheong region wide-area union is already operating, and discussions on integrating economic and living zones are underway. There’s no reason to back out over fears that Chungbuk might be marginalized. Chungbuk’s industrial structure centered on semiconductors, biotechnology, and secondary batteries is highly competitive. Its per capita GRDP is also in the top ranks nationally. In the trend of regionalization, I believe Chungbuk can actually play a central role.” (“큰 틀에서는 동의한다. 이미 충청권 광역연합이 운영되고 있고 경제권·생활권 통합 논의도 진행 중이다. 충북이 소외될 거라는 우려 때문에 발을 뺄 이유는 없다. 충북의 산업 구조는 반도체·바이오·이차전지 중심으로 굉장히 경쟁력이 있다. 1인당 GRDP도 전국 상위권이다. 광역화 흐름 속에서 충북이 오히려 중심 역할을 할 수 있다고 본다.”)

-Some Democratic Party candidates have expressed concerns about the party’s ‘fabricated indictment’ special counsel law. (-일부 민주당 후보들은 민주당의 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법에 대해 우려를 표했다.)

“In the field, it doesn’t feel like national political issues become direct core issues during local elections. However, if the People Power Party strategically uses it to launch attacks, it could have some impact. Since Chungbuk is a relatively conservative-leaning region, if provocative political issues flare up just before the election, it could be a burden for candidates.” (“현장에서 느끼기에는 지방선거 국면에서 국회 정치 현안이 직접적인 핵심 이슈가 되지는 않는다. 다만 국민의힘이 이를 정략적으로 활용해 공세를 펼칠 경우 일부 영향을 줄 수는 있다. 충북은 상대적으로 보수 성향이 강한 지역인 만큼 자극적인 정치 이슈가 선거 직전에 불거지면 후보 입장에서는 부담이 될 수도 있다.”)

-What public sentiment do you feel in the field? (-현장에서 느끼는 민심 어떤가.)

“Many of the residents who previously elected a People Power Party candidate as governor are now saying, ‘It’s time for a change.’ I’m not talking about generational shift just because of age. There’s a great fatigue with the oldness of Chungbuk politics. It’s a matter of whether to stay in the past or move toward the future. Especially on issues of future growth engines and jobs, I feel many residents are placing their hopes on me.” (“지난번 국민의힘 후보를 도지사로 만들었던 도민들도 ‘이제는 바꿔야 한다’는 이야기를 굉장히 많이 한다. 단순히 나이 때문에 세대교체를 말하는 게 아니다. 충북 정치의 낡음에 대한 피로감이 크다. 과거에 머물 것이냐, 미래로 갈 것이냐의 문제다. 특히 미래 먹거리와 일자리 문제에서는 저에게 기대를 거는 도민들이 많다고 느낀다.”)

-Candidate Kim Young-hwan said, “We mustn’t shake up the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership.” (-김영환 후보는 “장동혁 지도부를 흔들지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

“I resigned from the Yoon Suk Yeol government’s transition committee and left. Watching from close up, I felt it was a very dangerous leadership. Even after the December 3 martial law and impeachment, the People Power Party has shown no true reflection or repentance. Candidate Kim Young-hwan, far from breaking ties with former President Yoon Suk Yeol, has practically acted like his bodyguard. At the very least, he should apologize to the public and show he is drawing a line with former President Yoon.” (“저는 윤석열 정부 인수위 시절 사표를 내고 나온 사람이다. 가까이서 지켜보며 굉장히 위험한 리더십이라고 느꼈다. 국민의힘은 12·3 비상계엄과 탄핵까지 벌어졌는데도 진정한 반성과 참회가 없다. 김영환 후보 역시 윤석열 전 대통령과 절연하기는커녕 사실상 호위무사처럼 행동해왔다. 최소한 국민께 사과하고 윤 전 대통령과 선을 긋는 모습은 보여야 한다.”)

☞Who is Shin Yong-han (☞신용한은 누구)

Born in Cheongju, Chungbuk, he graduated from Cheongju High School and Yonsei University with degrees in Business Administration and Law. He served as the chair of the Youth Committee under the Park Geun-hye administration. In 2021, during the People Power Party’s primary for the presidential election, he was the operations director for Won Hee-ryong’s camp, and after Yoon Suk Yeol was confirmed as the candidate, he oversaw policy implementation in the camp. In 2024, he joined the Democratic Party as the 15th recruited talent by then-leader Lee Jae-myung. (충북 청주 출신으로 청주고와 연세대 경영학과·법학과를 졸업했다. 박근혜 정부에서 청년위원회 위원장을 지냈다. 2021년 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 원희룡 캠프 상황실장을 맡았고, 윤석열 후보로 확정된 후 캠프에서 정책 실무를 총괄했다. 2024년 이재명 당시 더불어민주당 대표의 15호 영입 인재로 민주당에 합류했다.)

item.title: Seoul, Now Wrangling over Yongsan Development… Jung Won-oh: “Supply 10,000 Units” Oh Se-hoon: “Are You Creating a Chicken Coop?” (서울, 이번엔 용산 개발 공방… 정원오 “1만호 공급” 오세훈 “닭장촌 만듭니까”)
item.description:
Seoul, Now Wrangling over Yongsan Development… Jung Won-oh: “Supply 10,000 Units” Oh Se-hoon: “Are You Creating a Chicken Coop?” (서울, 이번엔 용산 개발 공방… 정원오 “1만호 공급” 오세훈 “닭장촌 만듭니까”)

As real estate policy emerges as a key issue in the Seoul mayoral election, rival candidates clashed on the 8th over the Yongsan development issue. Regarding the development of the Yongsan International Business District, which has sparked controversy over "overcrowding" after the government announced plans to supply 10,000 housing units earlier this year, Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh said, "Whether it's 10,000 units or 8,000 units is ultimately a matter of adjustment." However, People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon countered, "Are you trying to build chicken coop apartments?" and demanded, "Withdraw the 10,000-unit pledge immediately." Yongsan District is an area where the People Power Party won in the last general and presidential elections. <<> Candidate Jung held a press conference at the Yongsan Maintenance Depot site, slated for development into an international business district, stating, "The maintenance depot site has been neglected for over 15 years due to the failure of Oh Se-hoon-style development," and proposed, "I will attract a UN AI (Artificial Intelligence) Hub to Yongsan." Regarding housing supply, he added, "If the government and Seoul city coordinate, we can find a consensus that benefits all citizens." <<> In May 2020, the government initially announced plans to supply 8,000 housing units in the Yongsan International Business District, but increased that to 10,000 units in August of the same year. Seoul city opposed this, citing insufficient schools, roads, and green spaces, and in 2022 agreed to develop 6,000 units. However, controversy reignited when the Yoon Suk-yeol administration announced plans again in January for 10,000 units. <<> Candidate Oh also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "The Yongsan International Business District is a strategic hub that should serve as the 'face of Seoul,'" and "Candidate Jung, who wants to reduce such a place to a chicken coop apartment complex, is shattering Seoul's future." He added, "The optimal housing supply is 6,000 units, and the agreed amount is 8,000 units—that number is the bottom line." <<> The two candidates also engaged in a war of nerves over redevelopment and reconstruction pledges. Candidate Oh announced a pledge the previous day to shorten the redevelopment period, but Candidate Jung's camp claimed this was a copy of Oh’s "Step-by-Step Development" pledge, which strengthens district autonomy to speed up redevelopment and reconstruction. In response, Candidate Oh said he had already pioneered the "Smart Planning" policy to support swift redevelopment projects, calling Jung's claim "exactly like a new restaurant opening next to a long-established galbi-tang (beef rib soup) shop and claiming it’s the original." (서울시장 선거에서 부동산 정책이 쟁점으로 떠오른 가운데 여야 후보들은 8일 용산 개발 문제를 놓고 충돌했다. 올 들어 정부가 주택 1만 가구 공급 계획을 발표해 ‘과밀화’ 논란이 있었던 용산국제업무지구 개발에 대해 더불어민주당 정원오 후보는 “1만호냐, 8000호냐는 결국 조정의 문제”라고 했다. 하지만 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 “닭장 아파트를 만들겠다는 거냐”며 “당장 1만호 공약을 철회하라”고 했다. 용산구는 지난 총선과 대선에서 국민의힘이 승리한 지역이다.)

item.title: Indictment Cancellation Backlash Becomes Reality… Daegu and Busan, Once Led by the Ruling Party, Now a Tight Race (공소취소 역풍 현실화… 與 앞섰던 대구·부산, 박빙 됐다)
item.description:
Indictment Cancellation Backlash Becomes Reality… Daegu and Busan, Once Led by the Ruling Party, Now a Tight Race (공소취소 역풍 현실화… 與 앞섰던 대구·부산, 박빙 됐다)

In the Yeongnam region, a key battleground for the June 3 local elections, multiple opinion polls have shown the candidates from the People Power Party and the Democratic Party in a tight race. This has halted the optimism within some ruling party circles who predicted victories in 15 cities and provinces excluding North Gyeongsang Province. Polling experts noted, "As the Democratic Party pushes for a special counsel law alleging a 'fabricated indictment'—keeping open the possibility of canceling the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung—the conservative base has accelerated its consolidation." (6·3 지방선거 격전지가 된 영남권에서 국민의힘 후보와 더불어민주당 후보가 박빙 승부를 벌이고 있다는 여론조사가 잇따라 발표됐다. 경북을 제외한 15개 시·도에서 승리할 것이라던 여권 일각의 낙관론에 제동이 걸린 형국이다. 여론조사 전문가들은 “민주당이 이재명 대통령 사건 공소취소 가능성을 열어놓은 ‘조작기소’ 특검법을 추진하면서 보수층 결집이 가속화됐다”고 했다.)

In a survey commissioned by JTBC and conducted by MetaVoice and Research Lab on the 5th and 6th, targeting 804 voters in Daegu (wireless phone interview), Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum scored 40% and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho scored 41% in the Daegu mayoral race. This marks a shift from the early trend where Kim had been leading amid public attention. Choo's camp said, "The atmosphere at Daegu's Seomun Market has changed," adding, "Since this month, more people are saying, 'We need to properly stop the Democratic Party.'" (JTBC 의뢰로 메타보이스·리서치랩이 지난 5~6일 대구 유권자 804명을 대상으로 실시한 대구시장 지지도 조사(무선 전화면접)에서 민주당 김부겸 후보는 40%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 41%로 나타났다. 여론의 주목을 받으며 김 후보가 앞서가던 초반 흐름이 달라진 것이다. 추 후보 측은 “대구 서문시장의 공기가 달라졌다”며 “이달 들어서 ‘민주당을 제대로 막아보라’는 분들이 늘어나고 있다”고 했다.)

In a Ulsan mayoral poll commissioned by KBS Ulsan and Ulsan Maeil Newspaper and conducted by Public Opinion Polling Fair on the 4th and 5th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook garnered 32.9% and People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-kyum received 37.1%, within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). Following them, Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon got 14.2% and independent Park Maeng-woo, who left the People Power Party, took 8.5%. As a result, candidate unification remains a variable in the Ulsan region. The survey was conducted via wireless automated response (ARS) and wired random digit dialing (RDD) targeting 804 voters in Ulsan. (KBS울산방송·울산매일신문 의뢰로 여론조사공정이 지난 4~5일 실시한 울산시장 지지도 조사에서 민주당 김상욱 후보 32.9%, 국민의힘 김두겸 후보 37.1%로 오차 범위(±3.5%포인트) 내였다. 뒤이어 김종훈 진보당 후보가 14.2%, 국민의힘에서 탈당한 박맹우 무소속 후보가 8.5%를 얻었다. 이 때문에 울산 지역은 후보 단일화가 여전히 변수다. 이 조사는 울산 지역 유권자 804명을 대상으로 무선 자동응답(ARS)과 유선 임의번호걸기(RDD) 방식으로 실시했다.)

The races for South Gyeongsang Province governor and Busan mayor are also neck-and-neck. In a wireless ARS survey commissioned by Gyeongnam Newspaper and conducted by Mono Research on the 1st and 2nd targeting 1,000 voters in South Gyeongsang Province, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo received 41.9% and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo got 44.1%. Another wireless ARS survey commissioned by Busan MBC and conducted by Han Gil Research on the 1st and 2nd targeting 1,013 voters in Busan showed Democratic Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeon Jae-soo at 46.9% and People Power Party candidate Park Heong-joon at 40.7%. The two candidates are within the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (경남지사와 부산시장 선거에서도 여야 후보가 접전을 벌이고 있다. 경남신문 의뢰로 모노리서치가 지난 1~2일 경남 유권자 1000명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 ARS 조사에서 민주당 김경수 후보가 41.9%, 국민의힘 박완수 후보가 44.1%를 얻었다. 부산MBC 의뢰로 한길리서치가 지난 1~2일 부산 지역 유권자 1013명을 상대로 실시한 무선 ARS 조사에서는 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보가 46.9%, 박형준 국민의힘 후보는 40.7%로 나타났다. 두 후보가 오차 범위(±3.1%포인트) 안에서 다투는 형국이다.)

In the three-way Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo is leading, but conservative candidates are close behind. A phone interview survey by MetaVoice commissioned by JTBC on the 4th and 5th targeting 501 voters in Busan North Gap found that 37% supported Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, 26% supported People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, and 25% backed independent candidate Han Dong-hoon. In hypothetical head-to-head matchups, Ha Jung-woo had 44% vs. Park Min-shik's 39%, and Ha Jung-woo had 42% vs. Han Dong-hoon's 36%, both within the margin of error. (3자 구도로 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에선 민주당 하정우 후보가 앞서고 있지만 보수 후보들의 추격도 만만치 않다. 메타보이스가 JTBC 의뢰로 지난 4~5일 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 501명에게 전화 면접 방식으로 물은 결과 민주당 하정우 후보를 지지한다는 응답이 37%로 나타났다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보 26%, 무소속 한동훈 후보는 25%였다. 가상 양자 대결에선 하정우 후보 44% 대 박민식 후보 39%, 하정우 후보 42% 대 한동훈 후보 36%로 오차범위 내였다.)

Within the opposition, there is analysis that the shifting sentiment in the Yeongnam region is a backlash check against the Democratic Party's "rampage." A People Power Party official said, "Conservative voters who said, 'I can't stand even looking at the People Power Party' due to martial law, impeachment, and internal strife, seem to have found justification for support following the Democratic Party's push for a special counsel on indictment cancellation." While the People Power Party's party approval ratings still lag far behind the Democratic Party, there is analysis of a "decoupling" effect, where the election is candidate-focused, causing candidate support to diverge from party support. (야권에선 영남권 민심이 요동치는 배경에 대해 민주당의 ‘폭주’에 따른 견제 심리라는 분석이 나온다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “계엄과 탄핵, 당 내분으로 ‘국민의힘은 꼴도 보기 싫다’고 했던 보수 유권자들이 민주당의 공소취소 특검 추진을 계기로 지지 명분을 얻은 것 같다”고 했다. 정당 지지율에서 국민의힘은 여전히 민주당에 큰 차이로 뒤지고 있지만, 선거가 후보 중심으로 진행되면서 당 지지율과 후보 지지율이 따로 가는 ‘디커플링(탈동조화)’이 나타나고 있다는 분석도 있다.)

Initially, ahead of the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party's approval rating fell to 15%, leading to predictions within the Democratic Party of a "sweep all the way to Yeongnam." Notably, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won said in an MBC interview last month, "We'll win 15 to 1, except for North Gyeongsang Province." (당초 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 정당 지지율이 15%까지 추락하면서 민주당 내부에선 “영남권까지 싹쓸이할 것”이란 전망이 제기됐다. 민주당 박지원 의원이 지난달 MBC 인터뷰에서 “15 대 1로 우리가 경북만 빼고 다 승리할 것”이라고 했던 것이 대표적이다.)

However, as the conservative base consolidates in the Yeongnam region, Democratic Party candidates in battleground areas are now issuing warnings to "maintain a low profile until the end." There are also signs of campaign camps striving to recruit moderate conservative figures. Amid this, the Democratic Party leadership is re-emphasizing the "insurrection judgment" narrative. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, teary-eyed during a party meeting today, said, "If the martial law had succeeded, President Lee Jae-myung and I might have ended up as crab feed." (그러나 영남권에서 보수층이 결집하는 흐름이 만들어지자 접전지 민주당 후보들을 중심으로 “끝까지 낮은 자세로 선거에 임해야 한다”는 경고음이 나온다. 후보 캠프에선 중도 보수 성향의 인사를 영입하는 데 공을 들이는 기류도 감지된다. 이런 가운데 민주당 지도부는 ‘내란 심판론’을 다시 강조하고 있다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 당 회의에서 “만약 계엄이 성공했더라면 이재명 대통령도, 저도 혹시 꽃게밥이 되지 않았겠느냐”며 울먹였다.)

item.title: No "Special Privilege" in Lee's Helicopter Transfer, Anti-Corruption Commission Reverses Its Stance (“李 헬기 이송 특혜 없었다” 말 바꾼 권익위)
item.description:
No "Special Privilege" in Lee's Helicopter Transfer, Anti-Corruption Commission Reverses Its Stance (“李 헬기 이송 특혜 없었다” 말 바꾼 권익위)

In 2024, President Lee Jae-myung (then leader of the Democratic Party of Korea), who was attacked with a knife in Busan and treated at Pusan National University Hospital, was transferred to Seoul National University Hospital via emergency helicopter. The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC), which had previously labeled this as "special privilege," reversed its conclusion after two years. The "Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC" launched a reinvestigation and found that the use of the emergency helicopter was "the result of an official transfer agreement between hospitals" and did not violate the code of conduct for public officials. <<> ACRC Chairman Chung Il-yeon announced the results of the "Operation of the Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC" on the 8th, which included these findings. Chairman Chung, appointed by President Lee, formed this task force shortly after taking office in early March and reinvestigated decisions made by the ACRC during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. <<> President Lee, then leader of the Democratic Party, was attacked in the neck with a knife on the morning of January 2, 2024, at the site of the new Gadeokdo Airport in Busan. He was transported to Pusan National University Hospital for treatment and later transferred to Seoul National University Hospital via emergency helicopter in the afternoon. The use of an emergency helicopter, despite the availability of treatment in Busan, sparked controversy over "special privilege." In July of that year, the ACRC concluded that it was indeed a privilege, stating that a doctor without proper authority—not the attending medical staff—had requested the helicopter dispatch, and the Busan Fire and Disaster Headquarters failed to verify whether the dispatch met regulatory requirements. It also noted violations of Seoul National University Hospital's internal regulations. <<> At the time, the ACRC demanded disciplinary action from the relevant institutions, saying that doctors from both hospitals and Busan fire officials had violated the code of conduct for public officials, which states that "no special privilege should be given to specific individuals." However, the case against President Lee's side, which allegedly requested the privilege, and Chun Joon-ho, then chief of staff for the party leader, was closed (no charges) due to the lack of a code of conduct applicable to members of the National Assembly. <<> However, the reinvestigation launched this year yielded different results. The Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC stated, "After re-interviewing hospital officials, we found that the transfer was an official decision made through consultation between hospitals, and the doctor's request for a helicopter was made within their authority." It recommended that the ACRC express regret (apologize) at the organizational level. Chairman Chung responded to the changed statements by saying, "If you ask whether the previous statements or the current ones are correct, it's difficult for us to answer," but added, "The previous conclusion was inappropriate." (2024년 부산에서 흉기 피습을 당해 부산대병원에서 치료를 받던 이재명 대통령(당시 더불어민주당 대표)이 응급 헬기를 이용해 서울대병원으로 옮겨진 것은 ‘특혜’라고 했던 국민권익위원회가 2년 만에 그 결론을 뒤집었다. ‘권익위 정상화 추진 태스크포스(TF)’가 재조사에 착수해 보니, 응급 헬기 이용은 ‘병원 간 공식적 전원(轉院) 협의 결과’로 공무원 행동강령 위반이 없었다는 것이다.)
