item.title: "Speed Over Bipartisanship" and "We Could Take All Committees" — National Assembly Speaker Candidates Abandon Neutrality for Party Loyalty (“협치보다 속도” “상임위 다 가질 수도”… 국회의장 후보들, 중립 내던지고 ‘당원 코드’)
item.description:
"Speed Over Bipartisanship" and "We Could Take All Committees" — National Assembly Speaker Candidates Abandon Neutrality for Party Loyalty (“협치보다 속도” “상임위 다 가질 수도”… 국회의장 후보들, 중립 내던지고 ‘당원 코드’)

Candidates from the Democratic Party of Korea vying for the position of National Assembly Speaker in the second half of the 22nd term—Cho Jung-sik (6th term), Park Ji-won (5th term), and Kim Tae-nyeon (5th term)—are engaging in a "show of distinctiveness" competition, mindful of hardline party members. Political observers note, "The National Assembly Speaker is supposed to be a politically neutral position without a party affiliation, but its significance is fading." (22대 후반기 국회의장 선거에 나선 더불어민주당 조정식(6선)·박지원(5선)· 김태년(5선) 의원이 강성 당원을 의식한 ‘선명성 경쟁’을 벌이고 있다. 정치권에서는 “국회의장은 당적을 갖지 않으면서 정치적 중립을 지켜야 하는 자리인데 그 의미가 퇴색되고 있다”는 지적이 나왔다.)

Since the Democratic Party holds a majority in the National Assembly, the winner of its internal primary will once again become the Speaker. Notably, this time, the voting ratio has been adjusted to 80% by lawmakers and 20% by party members for the first time. This has led to "pledges" tailored to appeal to hardline party members. (민주당이 국회 과반 의석을 가지고 있기 때문에, 이번에도 민주당 내부 경선에서 이긴 의원이 국회의장이 된다. 특히 이번에는 처음으로 의원 투표 비율을 80%로 줄이고 당원 투표를 20% 반영한다. 이 때문에 강성 당원을 의식한 ‘공약’들이 나오고 있다.)

In a Yonhap News interview released on the 8th, Rep. Cho Jung-sik stated, "The National Assembly Speaker, as a former ruling party member, should align with the government," adding, "Speed is more important than bipartisanship." He also proposed setting a deadline for negotiating the allocation of standing committees in the second half, and if the ruling and opposition parties fail to reach an agreement, the Democratic Party would take over all committees. (조정식 의원은 8일 공개된 연합뉴스 인터뷰에서 “국회의장은 여당 출신으로서 정부와 손발을 맞춰야 한다”며 “협치보다 속도가 중요하다”고 했다. 후반기 상임위 배분 협상은 기한을 정해두고 하고, 여야가 합의에 이르지 못하면 민주당이 전 상임위를 다 갖도록 하겠다고도 했다.)

On the same day, Rep. Kim Tae-nyeon appeared on Kim Ou-joon's YouTube channel and said, "I've proposed a bill that if a standing committee chair refuses to convene meetings, a secretary from another negotiating group can act as the chair and call meetings, and the chair can be replaced by a majority vote of committee members." This is aimed at allowing the Democratic Party to seize the chairmanship if the People Power Party's committee chairs block the unilateral processing of bills by refusing to hold meetings. (김태년 의원은 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 “상임위원장이 회의를 열지 않으면 다른 교섭단체 소속 간사가 위원장 직무대행이 돼 회의를 열 수 있게 하고, 해당 상임위 위원 과반 찬성으로 위원장을 교체할 수 있는 법안을 발의해 놨다”고 했다. 국민의힘 상임위원장이 회의를 열지 않는 방식으로 법안 일방 처리를 저지하면 민주당이 위원장 자리를 뺏을 수 있게 하겠다는 것이다.)

Political insiders remarked, "This is the first time we've seen people aspiring to be National Assembly Speaker hint at 'one-sided parliamentary operations.'" Rep. Park Ji-won wrote on Facebook, "I want to create a National Assembly that supports the success of the Lee Jae-myung government." He also said, "When public sentiment, party sentiment, and lawmakers' sentiment (the hearts of Democratic Party lawmakers) align, it becomes clear sentiment." (이를 두고 정치권 인사들은 “국회의장이 되겠다는 사람들이 ‘국회 일방 운영’을 예고하는 것은 처음 본다”고 했다. 박지원 의원은 페이스북 글을 통해 “이재명 정부 성공을 지원하는 국회를 만들고 싶다”고 했다. 그는 “민심, 당심, 의심(議心·민주당 의원들의 마음)이 하나가 되면 명심(明心)”이라고 했다.)

There is widespread anticipation that party member voting will be a key variable in this primary. With 152 Democratic Party lawmakers participating in the vote—though some may be absent due to local election campaigns—party member votes, when converted into lawmaker equivalents, amount to 38. In a survey conducted from the 2nd to the 4th by Straight News and Jo Won C&I, among Democratic Party supporters, Rep. Park garnered 52.2%, Rep. Cho 13.7%, and Rep. Kim 7.6%. Another survey by Cheonji Ilbo and Korea Information Research from the 27th to the 28th of last month showed 45.5% of Democratic Party supporters favoring Rep. Park, with Rep. Cho at 9.5% and Rep. Kim at 6.3%. (이번 경선에서 당원 투표가 변수가 될 것이란 전망이 지배적이다. 지방선거 출마 등으로 민주당 의원 152명이 투표에 참여하는데, 당원 투표를 의원으로 환산하면 38명에 이른다. 스트레이트뉴스·조원씨앤아이의 지난 2~4일 조사에서는 민주당 지지층에서 박 의원 52.2%, 조 의원 13.7%, 김 의원 7.6%로 나왔다. 천지일보·코리아정보리서치의 지난달 27~28일 조사에서도 민주당 지지층의 45.5%는 박 의원 지지였다. 조 의원은 9.5%, 김 의원은 6.3%였다.)

However, among lawmaker votes, there are reports that Rep. Cho, who recently served as President Lee's special adviser on political affairs, is receiving support from the pro-Lee faction. (반면, 의원 투표에서는 최근까지 이 대통령의 정무특보를 지낸 조 의원이 친명계의 지원을 받고 있다는 얘기가 나온다.)

]]>

item.title: Ruling Party's Pursuit of Constitutional Amendment Ultimately Fails (여당이 추진한 개헌 결국 무산)
item.description:
Ruling Party's Pursuit of Constitutional Amendment Ultimately Fails (여당이 추진한 개헌 결국 무산)

The constitutional amendment pushed forward by the Democratic Party of Korea without agreement from the People Power Party ultimately failed on the 8th. The amendment, pursued for the first time in 39 years since 1987, will now see its discussion postponed until after the local elections. (더불어민주당이 국민의힘과 합의 없이 밀어붙였던 개헌이 8일 결국 무산됐다. 1987년 이후 39년 만에 추진됐던 개헌은 지방선거 이후로 논의가 미뤄지게 됐다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared the suspension of the constitutional amendment process during a plenary session, stating, "As of today, the related procedures have been halted." The previous day, Woo had submitted the amendment to the plenary session with the aim of holding a national referendum concurrently with the June 3 local elections, but the People Power Party boycotted, citing opposition to a unilateral push. He then declared "vote failure due to insufficient quorum" and attempted a revote today. The People Power Party had been advocating for the amendment to be pursued after the local elections. (우원식 국회의장은 이날 국회 본회의에서 “오늘로써 (개헌) 관련 절차는 중단됐다”며 개헌안 처리 중단을 선언했다. 우 의장은 전날 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 국민투표에 부치려던 개헌안을 본회의에 상정했지만 국민의힘이 “일방적 추진에 반대한다”며 불참했다. 그러자 ‘의결정족수 부족에 따른 투표 불성립’을 선포하고 이날 재투표하려 했다. 국민의힘은 지방선거 이후 개헌을 추진하자고 해왔다.)

Following the failure of the amendment, Speaker Woo stated, "I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party, which brought political tactics and unreasonable arguments to scuttle the constitutional amendment." Democratic Party Spokesperson Lee Ju-hee said, "The People Power Party has openly admitted to being an accomplice to the insurrectionist forces." Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung expressed regret over the failure of the amendment, stating, "The people will find it hard to understand the reasons for opposing even a minimal constitutional amendment meant to safeguard the nation's security and democracy." (개헌안 처리가 무산되자 우 의장은 “정략과 억지 주장을 끌어들여 개헌을 무산시킨 국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표명하지 않을 수 없다”고 했다. 민주당 이주희 원내대변인은 “국민의힘은 스스로 내란 세력의 공범임을 만천하에 자인했다”고 했다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 개헌안 처리 무산에 대해 유감을 표하면서 “국민들은 국가의 안위와 민주주의를 지키기 위한 최소한의 개헌마저 반대한 이유를 납득하기 어려우실 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party said they would block any constitutional amendment lacking bipartisan agreement. Floor Leader Song Un-sok stated, "Extractive amendments, shoddy amendments, third-term amendments, and even the Yushin Constitution—all pursued without opposition consent—ended in dictatorship and misfortune." (국민의힘은 여야 합의 없는 개헌은 막겠다고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 “(야당 반대에도 강행된) 발췌 개헌, 사사오입 개헌, 3선 개헌, 유신헌법까지 결말은 모두 독재와 불행으로 점철됐다”고 했다.)

◇ Revote pursued without consultation with opposition… abandoned after public opinion worsened (◇野와 협의도 없이 재투표 추진… 여론 나빠지자 포기)

Although the vote on the constitutional amendment failed due to the People Power Party's boycott on the 7th, Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party maintained until the morning of the 8th that they would process the amendment that day. However, after the People Power Party announced a filibuster on all bills, including the amendment, Woo suspended its processing. Addressing the People Power Party, Speaker Woo said, "Can you escape the suspicion that you haven't severed ties with former President Yoon Suk-yeol, even by filibustering an amendment that would prevent you from even dreaming of an illegal martial law?" Woo, who criticized the People Power Party for 20 minutes from the chair, shed tears during his speech and struck the gavel angrily when declaring the session adjourned. (지난 7일 국민의힘의 불참으로 개헌안 투표가 불성립됐지만 8일 오전까지도 우원식 국회의장과 더불어민주당은 이날 개헌안을 처리하겠다고 했다. 하지만 국민의힘이 개헌안을 비롯한 모든 법안에 대해 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 예고하자 우 의장은 개헌안 처리를 중단했다. 우 의장은 국민의힘을 향해 “불법 계엄을 꿈도 못 꾸게 하는 개헌에 필리버스터까지 걸면서 윤석열 전 대통령과 절연하지 못했다는 의심에서 벗어날 수 있겠느냐”고 했다. 의장석에서 20분간 국민의힘을 비판한 우 의장은 발언 도중 눈물을 보였고, 산회를 선언할 때는 화가 난 듯 의사봉을 내리치기도 했다.)

As Woo spoke, lawmakers from both parties exchanged shouts in the plenary hall. Democratic Party lawmakers called the People Power Party the "party of insurrection," while the People Power Party retorted by calling the Democratic Party the "unconstitutional party." Democratic Party Floor Leader Park Chan-dae told reporters after the session, "What does strengthening parliamentary oversight to prevent insurrection and martial law, and mandating balanced national development, have to do with elections? The People Power Party will surely face judgment from the people." People Power Party Floor Leader Song Un-sok stated, "The end result of a constitutional amendment without bipartisan agreement is dictatorship." (우 의장이 발언하는 동안 여야 의원들은 본회의장에서 고성을 주고받았다. 민주당 의원들은 국민의힘 의원들을 향해 “내란 정당”이라고 했고, 국민의힘은 민주당을 향해 “위헌 정당”이라고 맞받았다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 본회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “내란이, 계엄이 다시는 일어나지 않도록 엄격하게 국회 통제권을 강화하고 국가 균형 발전을 의무화하는 게 선거와 무슨 관련이 있느냐”며 “(국민의힘은) 국민들로부터 심판을 분명히 받을 것”이라고 했다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 “여야 합의 없는 개헌의 결말은 독재”라고 했다.)

Although the amendment's passage was already difficult due to the People Power Party's early decision to oppose it as party policy, Speaker Woo maintained his position to hold plenary sessions and proceed with the vote on the 7th and 8th. Within the Democratic Party, some mentioned, "If it fails on the 8th, we are considering additional sessions on the 9th and 10th." To hold a national referendum on the amendment during the June 3 local elections, the amendment needed to pass the National Assembly by the 10th. Before the plenary session, President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party leadership criticized the People Power Party, which insisted on postponing the amendment until after the local elections and opposed its processing, by questioning, "Aren't you colluding with the insurrection?" There were also criticisms that the push for the amendment right before the local elections, while simultaneously pursuing a 'fabricated indictment' special counsel law that could dismiss President Lee's case, was an attempt to divert public attention after public opinion turned negative. (국민의힘이 일찌감치 당론으로 반대해 개헌안 통과가 어려운 상황이었지만 우 의장은 7일에 이어 8일에도 본회의를 열고 개헌안 투표를 하겠다는 입장이었다. 민주당에서는 “8일에 안 되면 9일, 10일 본회의도 검토하고 있다”는 말도 나왔다. 6·3 지방선거 때 개헌 국민투표를 하려면 10일까지는 개헌안이 국회를 통과해야 한다. 본회의에 앞서 이재명 대통령과 민주당 지도부는 지방선거 이후 개헌을 주장하며 개헌안 처리를 반대하는 국민의힘을 향해 “내란 동조 세력이 아니냐”는 취지로 비판했다. 지방선거 직전 개헌을 밀어붙이면서 이 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 추진했다가 여론이 악화되자 개헌으로 희석시키려는 게 아니냐는 지적까지 받기도 했다.)

Ultimately, with public opinion rising that "pushing through major national matters like a constitutional amendment without the consent of the main opposition party could lead to greater social chaos," the processing of the amendment was halted. Some in political circles remarked, "Wasn't it obvious they couldn't persuade the People Power Party? They pushed a hasty, election-oriented constitutional amendment show, and when public opinion worsened, they quietly folded while blaming the opposition." The People Power Party criticized, "Did Speaker Woo suddenly reverse his announced plan to resubmit the amendment because of his overseas travel schedule?" (결국 “개헌과 같은 국가 대사를 제1 야당의 합의 없이 밀어붙일 경우 사회적 혼란이 더 커질 수 있다”는 여론이 비등하면서 개헌안 처리는 중단됐다. 정치권에선 “국민의힘을 설득하지 못하는 걸 뻔히 알면서 선거용 졸속 개헌 쇼를 추진하다 여론이 악화되자 야당 탓을 하며 슬그머니 접은 것 아니냐”는 말도 나왔다. 국민의힘은 이날 “개헌안 재상정을 예고했던 우 의장이 갑자기 방침을 뒤집은 건 해외 순방 일정 때문 아니냐”고 비판했다.)

Speaker Woo, whose term as National Assembly Speaker ends on the 29th, is scheduled to embark on a roughly week-long trip to the Netherlands and Kenya starting the 10th. People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin said, "Is it because Speaker Woo needs to go on his 'Speaker's graduation trip' that he couldn't put the agenda item on the schedule?" Another Senior Spokesperson, Park Choong-kwon, added, "Since he scuttled the filibuster, (Speaker Woo) should enjoy his final overseas trip with a peace of mind." National Assembly Secretary General Cho O-seop, in a public notice, stated, "The schedule for expanding trade and investment cooperation with Kenya has been discussed since September last year, and the visit to the Netherlands is a diplomatic itinerary prepared over a significant period as a return visit to the Dutch House Speaker's visit to the National Assembly in January last year. We request Representatives Choi Soo-jin and Park Choong-kwon to retract their diplomatically discourteous remarks and issue a formal apology." (오는 29일 국회의장 임기가 종료되는 우 의장은 10일부터 약 일주일간 네덜란드·케냐 순방에 나설 예정이다. 최수진 국민의힘 원내수석대변인은 “우 의장이 ‘(의장) 졸업 여행’을 가야 해서 (일정상) 안건을 못 올린 것 아닌가”라고 했고, 박충권 원내수석대변인도 “필리버스터를 무산시켰으니 (우 의장은) 마지막 해외 출장 맘 편히 잘 다녀오라”고 했다. 조오섭 국회의장 비서실장은 언론 공지를 통해 “케냐와 작년 9월부터 무역 및 투자 협력 확대를 위한 교류 일정을 논의해 왔고, 네덜란드 방문은 작년 1월 네덜란드 하원의장의 국회 방문에 대한 답방 차원에서 상당 기간 준비한 외교 일정”이라며 “최수진·박충권 의원의 외교 결례적 발언 철회 및 공식 사과를 요청드린다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo had also planned to submit around 50 bills with bipartisan agreement during the plenary session. Ahead of the session, the Speaker's office criticized the People Power Party's planned filibuster while mentioning the processing of 'livelihood bills.' However, after the constitutional amendment's failure, Woo concluded the plenary session without submitting any bills, delaying their processing. A People Power Party official said, "Couldn't Speaker Woo have informed the opposition of his plan to halt the amendment processing beforehand and discussed the livelihood bills? It was Speaker Woo and the Democratic Party who used the livelihood bills for political purposes." (우 의장은 이날 본회의에 여야 간 이견이 없는 법안 50여 건도 상정할 예정이었다. 국회의장 측은 이날 본회의에 앞서 ‘민생 법안’ 처리를 언급하며 국민의힘의 필리버스터 계획을 비판하기도 했다. 그러나 개헌안 처리가 무산되자 우 의장은 법안을 상정하지 않고 본회의를 끝냈고, 법안 처리는 미뤄졌다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “우 의장이 개헌 추진 중단 방침을 미리 야당에 알리고 민생 법안 처리 논의를 할 수도 있었던 것 아니냐”며 “민생 법안을 정치적으로 이용한 건 오히려 우 의장과 민주당”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Simultaneous Office Openings (박민식·한동훈, 한날한시 개소식)

Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Simultaneous Office Openings (박민식·한동훈, 한날한시 개소식)

Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate, both running in the June 3 by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, will hold their campaign office opening ceremonies at 2 PM on the 10th, at the same time. Their offices are located a 10-minute walk apart (about 600 meters). As both candidates have expressed their intention to "complete the race" despite calls for "conservative unification," there are predictions on the 8th that this opening ceremony will take on the aspect of a "showdown of strength." <<> At the opening ceremony for candidate Park Min-sik, party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, floor leader Song Eon-seok, and other senior lawmakers are expected to attend in large numbers. Park's camp stated that "senior lawmakers such as Kwon Young-se, Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo, as well as several regional lawmakers from Busan, have also agreed to attend." The People Power Party's central office plans to go all out in supporting Park, even operating a press support bus—something they did not arrange when party leader Jang visited the openings of Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho and Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-jun. <<> Within the opposition, there are murmurs that "Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk will strongly check Han's independent candidacy through his congratulatory speech." Park has recently been appearing one after another on conservative YouTube channels, seeking to rally the hardcore supporter base. <<> Ahead of the opening ceremony, former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo and former lawmaker Jeong Mi-kyung have joined Han Dong-hoon's campaign. Seo, a former Busan mayor and five-term lawmaker, left the People Power Party the previous day and agreed to serve as honorary campaign committee chairman. Former lawmaker Jeong Hyung-geun, who previously served as a lawmaker for Busan North and Gangseo Gap, was brought in as the fundraising committee chairman. Regarding the controversy over Jeong’s past career at the Agency for National Security Planning (ANSP), Han stated in an MBC radio interview that day: "I do not agree with everything he has done." <<> It has been reported that Han dissuaded pro-Han lawmakers within the People Power Party from attending his opening ceremony. On MBC Radio, Han said, "To the lawmakers who expressed their intention to attend, I conveyed that I would appreciate it if they could just send their support from afar." Many pro-Han lawmakers, including Han Ji-ah and Jin Jong-oh, had originally planned to attend Han's ceremony but decided not to after Han's request. <<> Meanwhile, Ha Jung-woo, the candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea, is also holding his opening ceremony on the same day, signaling that the Busan North Gap election is set to heat up in earnest. (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마하는 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 10일 오후 2시, 같은 시각에 선거사무소 개소식을 갖는다. 이들의 사무소는 도보로 10분 거리(약 600m)다. 두 후보 모두 ‘보수 단일화’ 요구에 대해 ‘완주’ 의지를 밝힌 만큼, 이번 개소식이 ‘세(勢) 대결’ 양상을 띨 것이란 전망이 8일 나온다.)
